<file path="native/host.cs">
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;

class Program {
    static int Main(string[] args) {
        try {
            string dir = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
            string script = Path.Combine(dir, "host.js");
            string node = @"C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe";
            if (!File.Exists(node)) {
                node = "node";
            }

            ProcessStartInfo psi = new ProcessStartInfo();
            psi.FileName = node;
            psi.Arguments = "\"" + script + "\"";
            psi.UseShellExecute = false;
            psi.RedirectStandardInput = true;
            psi.RedirectStandardOutput = true;
            psi.RedirectStandardError = false;
            psi.CreateNoWindow = true;

            using (Process p = Process.Start(psi)) {
                Thread tIn = new Thread(() => {
                    try {
                        using (Stream cin = Console.OpenStandardInput())
                        using (Stream pin = p.StandardInput.BaseStream) {
                            byte[] inBuf = new byte[8192];
                            int r;
                            while ((r = cin.Read(inBuf, 0, inBuf.Length)) > 0) {
                                pin.Write(inBuf, 0, r);
                                pin.Flush();
                            }
                        }
                    } catch {}
                });
                tIn.IsBackground = true;
                tIn.Start();

                Thread tOut = new Thread(() => {
                    try {
                        using (Stream pout = p.StandardOutput.BaseStream)
                        using (Stream cout = Console.OpenStandardOutput()) {
                            byte[] outBuf = new byte[8192];
                            int r;
                            while ((r = pout.Read(outBuf, 0, outBuf.Length)) > 0) {
                                cout.Write(outBuf, 0, r);
                                cout.Flush();
                            }
                        }
                    } catch {}
                });
                tOut.IsBackground = true;
                tOut.Start();

                p.WaitForExit();
                tOut.Join(500);
                return p.ExitCode;
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            File.AppendAllText(Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "host_error.log"), ex.ToString() + "\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="native/host.sh">
#!/bin/bash
DIR="$( cd "$( dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" >/dev/null 2>&1 && pwd )"
NODE_BIN="$(which node 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ] || [ ! -x "$NODE_BIN" ]; then
  if [ -x "/opt/homebrew/bin/node" ]; then
    NODE_BIN="/opt/homebrew/bin/node"
  elif [ -x "/usr/local/bin/node" ]; then
    NODE_BIN="/usr/local/bin/node"
  elif [ -x "/usr/bin/node" ]; then
    NODE_BIN="/usr/bin/node"
  fi
fi

if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ]; then
  echo "Node.js not found. Please install Node.js." >&2
  exit 1
fi

exec "$NODE_BIN" "$DIR/host.js"
</file>

@echo off
setlocal
echo [Savior] Installing Savior Native Download Helper...

set "MANIFEST_PATH=%~dp0com.savior.helper.json"
set "HOST_PATH=%~dp0host.exe"

:: Escape backslashes for JSON
set "HOST_PATH_ESC=%HOST_PATH:\=\\%"

:: Write absolute path into com.savior.helper.json
(
  echo {
  echo   "name": "com.savior.helper",
  echo   "description": "Savior Native Download Helper",
  echo   "path": "%HOST_PATH_ESC%",
  echo   "type": "stdio",
  echo   "allowed_origins": [
  echo     "chrome-extension://nnjbdidmmnecdmcllkcaajboplpcimcf/"
  echo   ]
  echo }
) > "%MANIFEST_PATH%"

:: Register with Google Chrome in HKCU
reg add "HKCU\Software\Google\Chrome\NativeMessagingHosts\com.savior.helper" /ve /t REG_SZ /d "%MANIFEST_PATH%" /f >nul

:: Register with CocCoc Browser (both keys)
reg add "HKCU\Software\CocCoc\NativeMessagingHosts\com.savior.helper" /ve /t REG_SZ /d "%MANIFEST_PATH%" /f >nul 2>&1
reg add "HKCU\Software\CocCoc\Browser\NativeMessagingHosts\com.savior.helper" /ve /t REG_SZ /d "%MANIFEST_PATH%" /f >nul 2>&1

:: Register with Microsoft Edge
reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Edge\NativeMessagingHosts\com.savior.helper" /ve /t REG_SZ /d "%MANIFEST_PATH%" /f >nul 2>&1

:: Register with Brave Browser
reg add "HKCU\Software\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\NativeMessagingHosts\com.savior.helper" /ve /t REG_SZ /d "%MANIFEST_PATH%" /f >nul 2>&1

echo.
echo [SUCCESS] Savior Native Helper registered successfully for Chrome, CocCoc, Edge, and Brave!
echo You can now download videos, HLS streams, and YouTube 1080p+ with FFmpeg in Chrome.

<file path="native/uninstall.sh">
#!/bin/bash
set -e

TARGET_DIRS=(
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/NativeMessagingHosts"
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Chromium/NativeMessagingHosts"
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser/NativeMessagingHosts"
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Microsoft Edge/NativeMessagingHosts"
)

for TARGET_DIR in "${TARGET_DIRS[@]}"; do
  MANIFEST="$TARGET_DIR/com.savior.helper.json"
  if [ -f "$MANIFEST" ]; then
    rm -f "$MANIFEST"
    echo "Removed $MANIFEST"
  fi
done

echo "Savior Native Helper uninstalled successfully from macOS."
</file>

<file path="scripts/build_inject.js">
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const ROOT_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const SRC_INJECT = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'src', 'inject');
const DEST_INJECT = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'inject');

function copyDir(src, dest) {
  fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(src, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const srcPath = path.join(src, entry.name);
    const destPath = path.join(dest, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      copyDir(srcPath, destPath);
    } else {
      fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, destPath);
    }
  }
}

console.log('=== BUILDING INJECT EXTRACTORS ===\n');
copyDir(SRC_INJECT, DEST_INJECT);
console.log('✓ Successfully synchronized inject extractors from src/inject/ to inject/!\n');
</file>

<file path="scripts/regenerate_slots.js">
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const reg = require('../src/content/module-registry.js');

console.log('Regenerating src/content/slots.js...');

const TOTAL_SLOTS = 776;
const importLines = [];
const slotArray = [];

for (let i = 0; i < TOTAL_SLOTS; i++) {
  const relPath = reg.modules[i];
  if (relPath) {
    importLines.push(`import m${i} from './${relPath}';`);
    slotArray.push(`  m${i}`);
  } else {
    slotArray.push('  null');
  }
}

const slotsCode = `${importLines.join('\n')}\n\nexport default [\n${slotArray.join(',\n')}\n];\n`;

fs.writeFileSync(path.resolve(__dirname, '..', 'src', 'content', 'slots.js'), slotsCode, 'utf8');
console.log('Successfully regenerated src/content/slots.js!');
</file>

<file path="scripts/unpack_modules.js">
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const acorn = require('acorn');

console.log('=== UNPACKING CONTENT SCRIPT MODULES ===\n');

const csPath = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', 'content-script.js');
const csCode = fs.readFileSync(csPath, 'utf8');

console.log(`Parsing ${csPath}...`);
const ast = acorn.parse(csCode, { ecmaVersion: 2022 });

// Locate CSS prefetcher (statements 0 to 7)
const cssPrefetcherCode = csCode.slice(ast.body[0].start, ast.body[7].end).trim();

// Locate Webpack statement
const webpackStmt = ast.body.find(stmt => 
  stmt.type === 'ExpressionStatement' &&
  stmt.expression.type === 'UnaryExpression' &&
  stmt.expression.argument.type === 'CallExpression' &&
  stmt.expression.argument.arguments.length > 0 &&
  stmt.expression.argument.arguments[0].type === 'ArrayExpression'
);

if (!webpackStmt) {
  throw new Error('Could not find Webpack array in content-script.js');
}

const moduleArray = webpackStmt.expression.argument.arguments[0];
const totalSlots = moduleArray.elements.length;

const baseDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', 'src', 'content');
const dirs = [
  'vendor/elliptic',
  'vendor/parser',
  'vendor',
  'crypto',
  'platform',
  'detector',
  'widget',
  'providers',
  'entry'
];

dirs.forEach(d => fs.mkdirSync(path.join(baseDir, d), { recursive: true }));

const elliptic = new Set([126, 437, 485, 618, 652, 668, 643, 433, 443]);
const parser = new Set([37, 89]);
const crypto = new Set([161, 71, 72, 73, 74, 75, 45, 46, 47, 48, 16, 17, 18]);

const modulesMap = {};
const registrySlotsLines = [];

let unpackedCount = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < totalSlots; i++) {
  const el = moduleArray.elements[i];
  if (!el) {
    registrySlotsLines.push('  null');
    continue;
  }

  unpackedCount++;
  const modCode = csCode.slice(el.start, el.end).trim();
  let category = 'platform';

  if (elliptic.has(i)) {
    category = 'vendor/elliptic';
  } else if (parser.has(i)) {
    category = 'vendor/parser';
  } else if (crypto.has(i) || modCode.includes('AES') || modCode.includes('CryptoJS') || modCode.includes('HMAC')) {
    category = 'crypto';
  } else if (modCode.includes('savior-widget') || modCode.includes('FloatingBar') || modCode.includes('download-button') || modCode.includes('tooltip')) {
    category = 'widget';
  } else if (modCode.includes('video') || modCode.includes('m3u8') || modCode.includes('mp4') || modCode.includes('scanner') || modCode.includes('mutation')) {
    category = 'detector';
  } else if (modCode.includes('youtube') || modCode.includes('tiktok') || modCode.includes('facebook') || modCode.includes('instagram')) {
    category = 'providers';
  } else if (modCode.includes('regenerator-runtime') || modCode.includes('core-js') || modCode.includes('lodash')) {
    category = 'vendor';
  }

  const fileName = `module-${i}.js`;
  const relPath = `${category}/${fileName}`;
  const fullPath = path.join(baseDir, relPath);

  const fileContent = `// Module ${i} [${category}]\nmodule.exports = ${modCode};\n`;
  fs.writeFileSync(fullPath, fileContent, 'utf8');

  modulesMap[i] = relPath;
  registrySlotsLines.push(`  /* ${i} */ require('./${relPath}')`);
}

console.log(`Unpacked ${unpackedCount} modules across ${dirs.length} categories.`);

// Generate src/content/module-registry.js
const registryCode = `// Generated Module Registry for Savior Content Script
module.exports = {
  modules: ${JSON.stringify(modulesMap, null, 2)},
  slots: [
${registrySlotsLines.join(',\n')}
  ]
};
`;

const registryPath = path.join(baseDir, 'module-registry.js');
fs.writeFileSync(registryPath, registryCode, 'utf8');
console.log(`Wrote module registry to ${registryPath}`);

// Generate src/content/entry/index.js
const entryCode = `// Savior Content Script - Modular Open-Source Architecture
// Generated from transparent modular source in src/content/

// --- SECTION 1: CSS PREFETCHER & INVALIDATOR GUARD ---
${cssPrefetcherCode}

// --- SECTION 2: WEBPACK RUNTIME BOOTSTRAP ---
const registry = require('../module-registry');

(function(modules) {
  var installedModules = {};

  function __webpack_require__(moduleId) {
    if (installedModules[moduleId]) {
      return installedModules[moduleId].exports;
    }

    var module = installedModules[moduleId] = {
      i: moduleId,
      l: false,
      exports: {}
    };

    if (!modules[moduleId]) {
      throw new Error('Module ' + moduleId + ' not found in registry');
    }

    modules[moduleId].call(module.exports, module, module.exports, __webpack_require__);
    module.l = true;
    return module.exports;
  }

  __webpack_require__.m = modules;
  __webpack_require__.c = installedModules;

  __webpack_require__.d = function(exports, name, getter) {
    if (!__webpack_require__.o(exports, name)) {
      Object.defineProperty(exports, name, { enumerable: true, get: getter });
    }
  };

  __webpack_require__.r = function(exports) {
    if (typeof Symbol !== 'undefined' && Symbol.toStringTag) {
      Object.defineProperty(exports, Symbol.toStringTag, { value: 'Module' });
    }
    Object.defineProperty(exports, '__esModule', { value: true });
  };

  __webpack_require__.t = function(value, mode) {
    if (1 & mode) value = __webpack_require__(value);
    if (8 & mode) return value;
    if (4 & mode && typeof value === 'object' && value && value.__esModule) return value;
    var ns = Object.create(null);
    __webpack_require__.r(ns);
    Object.defineProperty(ns, 'default', { enumerable: true, value: value });
    if (2 & mode && typeof value !== 'string') {
      for (var key in value) __webpack_require__.d(ns, key, function(key) { return value[key]; }.bind(null, key));
    }
    return ns;
  };

  __webpack_require__.n = function(module) {
    var getter = module && module.__esModule ? function() { return module['default']; } : function() { return module; };
    __webpack_require__.d(getter, 'a', getter);
    return getter;
  };

  __webpack_require__.o = function(object, property) {
    return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, property);
  };

  __webpack_require__.p = './';

  // Boot entry module 543
  return __webpack_require__(__webpack_require__.s = 543);
})(registry.slots);
`;

const entryPath = path.join(baseDir, 'entry', 'index.js');
fs.writeFileSync(entryPath, entryCode, 'utf8');
console.log(`Wrote entry point to ${entryPath}\n`);
console.log('✓ Unpacking complete!');
</file>

<file path="src/content/detector/dash-parser.js">
// Module 28 [detector] - Savior DASH Manifest Parser and YouTube Stream Handler
export default function(module, exports, require) {
  "use strict";

  require.d(exports, "b", () => parseDashStream);

  var cryptoUtils = require(0);
  var featureFlags = require(11);
  var urlUtils = require(3);
  var xmlParser = require(44);
  var qualityHelper = require(9);
  var mediaConstants = require(1);
  var astParser = require(89);
  var formatDefinitions = require(90);

  function checkDashSupport(targetMap) {
    if (!(targetMap instanceof Map && targetMap.size !== 0 && featureFlags.a.DASH_DOWNLOAD)) {
      return Promise.resolve(null);
    }
    var firstEntry = targetMap.entries().next().value;
    var videoId = firstEntry ? firstEntry[0] : void 0;
    var mediaItem = firstEntry ? firstEntry[1] : void 0;

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      Object(cryptoUtils.getYoutubeDashMPDInfo)(videoId).then(mpdXml => {
        if (!mpdXml) {
          reject(mpdXml);
          return;
        }
        resolve(parseMpdPeriod(mediaItem, mpdXml));
      });
    });
  }

  function parseMpdPeriod(baseItem, xmlContent) {
    var parsedXml = Object(xmlParser.parse)(xmlContent, {
      attributeNamePrefix: "",
      attrNodeName: "@",
      textNodeName: "#text",
      ignoreAttributes: false,
      cdataTagName: "__cdata"
    });
    try {
      var adaptationSet = parsedXml.MPD.Period.AdaptationSet;
      if (location.host.includes("videojs.github.io")) {
        var videoSet = adaptationSet.find(set => set["@"].contentType.includes("video"));
        var audioSet = adaptationSet.find(set => set["@"].contentType.includes("audio"));
        return {
          ext: "mp4",
          resolution: videoSet["@"].height + "p",
          _dash_video_id: videoSet["@"].id,
          url: {
            videoUrl: videoSet.Representation.BaseURL,
            audioUrl: audioSet.Representation.BaseURL
          }
        };
      }
      var videoKey = Object.keys(adaptationSet).find(keyName => adaptationSet[keyName]["@"].mimeType.includes("video"));
      return adaptationSet[videoKey].Representation.map(repItem => {
        var mergedItem = Object.assign({}, baseItem, {
          resolution: repItem["@"].height + "p",
          _dash_video_id: repItem["@"].id
        });
        var resultDescriptor = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(mergedItem));
        if (resultDescriptor.resolution) {
          resultDescriptor.quality = qualityHelper.b.getQualityBySize(parseInt(resultDescriptor.resolution, 10));
        }
        if (resultDescriptor.i18n_quality && resultDescriptor.quality && resultDescriptor.i18n_quality !== resultDescriptor.quality) {
          resultDescriptor.i18n_quality = resultDescriptor.quality;
        }
        return resultDescriptor;
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(err);
      return null;
    }
  }

  function regeneratorCore() {
    /*! regenerator-runtime -- Copyright (c) 2014-present, Facebook, Inc. -- license (MIT): https://github.com/babel/babel/blob/main/packages/babel-helpers/LICENSE */
    (regeneratorCore = function() {
      return { w: wrapFn, m: markFn };
    })();
  }
  function wrapFn(stepFn) { return stepFn; }
  function markFn(genFn) { return genFn; }

  var asyncRunner = function(thisArg, extraArg1, extraArg2, generator) {
    return new (extraArg2 || (extraArg2 = Promise))(function(resolve, reject) {
      function step(result) {
        try {
          advance(generator.next(result));
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      }
      function fail(err) {
        try {
          advance(generator.throw(err));
        } catch (err2) {
          reject(err2);
        }
      }
      function advance(stepResult) {
        var val;
        if (stepResult.done) {
          resolve(stepResult.value);
        } else {
          val = stepResult.value;
          (val instanceof extraArg2 ? val : new extraArg2(function(res) { res(val); })).then(step, fail);
        }
      }
      advance((generator = generator.apply(thisArg, extraArg1 || [])).next());
    });
  };

  var FPS_WEIGHT_MAP = { 30: 0, 50: 25, 60: 50 };
  var YOUTUBE_FEATURE_FLAGS = featureFlags.a.YT;
  var AUDIO_CONTAINER_MAP = { webm: "weba", mp4: "mp4" };
  var IGNORED_CONTAINERS = ["m4a"];
  var videoMetadataCache = {};

  function fetchAndProcessMetadata(targetUrl, options) {
    var videoId = Object(cryptoUtils.getVideoId)(targetUrl) || targetUrl;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      var fetchPromise = location.hostname.match(/(www\.)?youtube\.com/i)
        ? astParser.a.getMetadata(videoId, options)
        : Object(cryptoUtils.sendMessage)({ type: mediaConstants.b.GET_URL, params: { frameUrl: targetUrl } }).then(res => res ? res.data : void 0);

      fetchPromise
        .catch(() => Object(cryptoUtils.getYoutubeInfo)(targetUrl))
        .then(metadata => {
          videoMetadataCache[videoId] = metadata;
          if (metadata.formats[0].ext === "m3u8") {
            resolve(metadata.formats);
            return;
          }
          processHtml5PlayerFormats(resolve, metadata);
        })
        .catch(err => reject(err));
    });
  }

  function processHtml5PlayerFormats(resolveFn, metadata) {
    var playerStreamingData, adaptiveFormats;
    if (!metadata) {
      console.log("Youtube config invalid");
      resolveFn([]);
      return;
    }
    if (!metadata.formats.length && (adaptiveFormats = metadata.playerResponse && metadata.playerResponse.streamingData && metadata.playerResponse.streamingData.adaptiveFormats) && adaptiveFormats.length) {
      metadata.formats = metadata.playerResponse.streamingData.adaptiveFormats;
    }

    var moviePlayerElem = document.querySelector("#movie_player");
    metadata.html5player = metadata.html5player || (moviePlayerElem ? moviePlayerElem.getAttribute("data-version") : "") || "";

    if (metadata.html5player && !metadata.formats[0].url) {
      fetch("https://www.youtube.com/" + metadata.html5player)
        .then(response => response.text())
        .then(playerScriptText => {
          var cipherRegex = /([a-zA-Z]+)(=function\([a-z]\))({a=a.split\(""\);(?!var)+?([\s\S])+?(}))/;
          var matchResult = playerScriptText.match(cipherRegex);
          var specialCharRegex = new RegExp(/[!@#$%^&*_+]/g);

          if (!metadata.formats[0].url && metadata.formats[0].signatureCipher && matchResult) {
            var rawFuncCode = matchResult[0];
            var funcNameTokens = rawFuncCode.split(";")[1];
            var funcName = funcNameTokens ? funcNameTokens.match(/\w+/g)[0] : void 0;
            var subFuncRegex = new RegExp("(\\s|\\n\\r)+" + funcName + "={+?([\\s\\S])+?(};)", "g");
            if (funcName && funcName.match(specialCharRegex)) {
              subFuncRegex = new RegExp("(\\s|\\n\\r)+\\" + funcName + "={+?([\\s\\S])+?(};)", "g");
            }
            var subFuncMatch = playerScriptText.match(subFuncRegex);
            var subFuncCode = subFuncMatch ? subFuncMatch[0] : "";
            window.subFunc = window.eval(subFuncCode || "");

            var replaceRegex = new RegExp("" + funcName, "g");
            rawFuncCode = rawFuncCode.replace(replaceRegex, "window.subFunc");
            if (rawFuncCode.match(specialCharRegex)) {
              rawFuncCode = rawFuncCode.replace(/[!@#$%^&*_+]/g, "\\$&").replace(replaceRegex, "window.subFunc");
            }
            var decipherFunction = window.eval(rawFuncCode);
            extractFormatsFromConfig(resolveFn, metadata, decipherFunction);
          }
        });
      return;
    }
    extractFormatsFromConfig(resolveFn, metadata);
  }

  function parseDashStream(targetUrl) {
    return asyncRunner(this, void 0, void 0, regeneratorCore().m(function generatorFn() {
      var videoId, cachedItem;
      return regeneratorCore().w(function iteratorStep(stepState) {
        for (;;) switch (stepState.p = stepState.n) {
          case 0:
            videoId = Object(cryptoUtils.getVideoId)(targetUrl) || targetUrl;
            cachedItem = videoMetadataCache[videoId];
            if (!cachedItem) {
              stepState.n = 1;
              break;
            }
            return stepState.a(2, cachedItem);
          case 1:
            stepState.p = 1;
            stepState.n = 2;
            return fetchAndProcessMetadata(targetUrl);
          case 2:
            stepState.n = 4;
            break;
          case 3:
            stepState.p = 3;
            return stepState.a(2, void 0);
          case 4:
            return stepState.a(2, videoMetadataCache[videoId]);
        }
      }, generatorFn, null, [[1, 3]]);
    }));
  }

  function extractFormatsFromConfig(resolveFn, metadata, decipherFn) {
    var videoDetailsTitle, audioBuckets = {}, videoList = [], dashMap = new Map(), subtitleMap = null;

    if (featureFlags.a.SUBTITLES) {
      subtitleMap = extractSubtitles(metadata, ["en", "vi", "ko", "ja", "fr", "ru", "de", "zh-Hans"]);
    }

    if (!metadata.title) {
      videoDetailsTitle = metadata.videoDetails ? metadata.videoDetails.title : void 0;
      metadata.title = videoDetailsTitle || document.title;
    }

    var processedFormats = metadata.formats.map(formatItem => {
      if (formatItem.isDashMPD && dashMap.has(formatItem.url)) return null;

      var qualityLabel = formatItem.qualityLabel || formatItem.resolution || "";
      var baseResolution = qualityLabel.includes("HDR") ? qualityLabel : qualityLabel.replace(/([0-9]{3,5}p).*/, "$1");
      var cleanResolution = qualityLabel.replace(/([0-9]{3,5}p\d{0,3}).*/, "$1");
      var fpsKey = (formatItem.fps && FPS_WEIGHT_MAP[formatItem.fps.toString()] ? formatItem.fps : 30).toString();

      if (baseResolution && mediaConstants.r[baseResolution]) {
        formatItem.quality = mediaConstants.r[baseResolution].label;
      }
      var qualityScore = mediaConstants.r[baseResolution] ? mediaConstants.r[baseResolution].value : 0;
      qualityScore += FPS_WEIGHT_MAP[fpsKey] || 0;

      if (!formatItem.url && formatItem.signatureCipher) {
        var cipherSig = formatItem.signatureCipher.split("&")[0].split("=")[1];
        if (cipherSig) {
          var decryptedSig = decipherFn ? decipherFn(decodeURIComponent(cipherSig)) : void 0;
          var urlMatch = formatItem.signatureCipher.match(/url=[\s\S]+/g);
          var matchedUrl = urlMatch ? urlMatch[0].split("=")[1] : "";
          formatItem.url = decodeURIComponent(matchedUrl) + "&sig=" + decryptedSig;
        }
      }

      if (!formatItem.container) {
        var parsedMime = Object(urlUtils.d)(formatItem.mimeType);
        formatItem.container = (parsedMime ? parsedMime.ext : void 0) || "mp4";
      }

      var i18nLabel;
      try {
        var qualDef = mediaConstants.r[baseResolution];
        i18nLabel = formatItem.i18n_quality || Object(cryptoUtils.i18n)(qualDef ? qualDef.i18n_label : void 0) || formatItem.quality;
      } catch (err) {
        i18nLabel = formatItem.quality;
      }

      var mediaItem = {
        ext: formatItem.container,
        filename: metadata.title,
        title: metadata.title,
        quality: formatItem.quality,
        i18n_quality: i18nLabel,
        url: formatItem.url,
        type: Object(cryptoUtils.getMediaType)(formatItem.type || formatItem.mimeType || "", formatItem.container),
        resolution: cleanResolution,
        referrer: formatItem.referrer || (metadata.videoDetails ? metadata.videoDetails.video_url : metadata.video_url) || location.href,
        sortValues: { qualityValue: parseInt(qualityScore.toString(), 10) },
        hasAudio: Boolean(formatItem.audioQuality),
        audioQuality: formatItem.audioQuality
      };

      if (mediaItem.type === "audio" && formatItem.audioTrack) {
        mediaItem.quality = formatItem.audioTrack.displayName;
        mediaItem.i18n_quality = formatItem.audioTrack.displayName;
        var itagInfo = formatDefinitions.c[formatItem.itag];
        if (itagInfo && itagInfo.audioBitrate) {
          mediaItem.resolution = itagInfo.audioBitrate + "kbps";
        }
        if (mediaItem.ext === "mp4") {
          mediaItem.ext = "mp3";
        }
      }

      if (formatItem.isDashMPD) {
        mediaItem._isDashMPD = formatItem.isDashMPD;
        dashMap.set(formatItem.url, mediaItem);
        return null;
      }

      var parsedUrlObj = Object(urlUtils.f)(formatItem.url);
      if (parsedUrlObj.host) {
        mediaItem.altUrl = Object(urlUtils.b)(parsedUrlObj);
      }

      if (!formatItem.audioBitrate && formatItem.audioQuality) {
        formatItem.audioBitrate = formatItem.bitrate;
      }

      if (!formatItem.encoding && formatItem.audioQuality && formatItem.audioBitrate) {
        if (!audioBuckets[formatItem.container]) {
          audioBuckets[formatItem.container] = [];
        }
        audioBuckets[formatItem.container].push(formatItem);
      }

      if (!formatItem.audioEncoding && !formatItem.isDashMPD && mediaItem.type !== "audio") {
        videoList.push(mediaItem);
      }

      return mediaItem;
    }).filter(Boolean);

    videoList.forEach(videoItem => {
      var mappedExt = AUDIO_CONTAINER_MAP[videoItem.ext];
      var candidateAudios = [...(audioBuckets[mappedExt] || []), ...(audioBuckets.mp3 || [])];
      var originalAudios = candidateAudios.filter(audioItem => {
        var track = audioItem.audioTrack;
        return track && track.displayName && track.displayName.includes("original");
      });

      var selectedAudio = originalAudios.find(audioItem => {
        var resNumMatch = /\d+/.exec(videoItem.resolution || "");
        var resNumber = Number(resNumMatch ? resNumMatch[0] : 0);
        return resNumber >= 480
          ? audioItem.audioQuality && audioItem.audioQuality.toLowerCase().includes("medium")
          : audioItem.audioQuality && audioItem.audioQuality.toLowerCase().includes("low");
      }) || originalAudios[0] || candidateAudios[0];

      if (!selectedAudio || !YOUTUBE_FEATURE_FLAGS[mappedExt]) {
        videoItem.url = "";
        videoItem.quality = "";
        return;
      }

      var videoStreamUrl = videoItem.url;
      videoItem.url = {
        videoUrl: String(videoStreamUrl),
        audioUrl: selectedAudio.url
      };
    });

    var subtitleItems = [];
    if (subtitleMap) {
      subtitleItems = Object.keys(subtitleMap).map(langKey => {
        var subUrl = subtitleMap[langKey];
        if (subUrl) {
          var subParsed = Object(urlUtils.f)(subUrl);
          subParsed.ext = "yt_srt";
          subParsed.i18n_ext = "srt";
          subParsed.filename = metadata.title;
          subParsed.title = metadata.title;
          subParsed.quality = langKey;
          subParsed.type = "subtitles";
          subParsed.isSubtitles = true;
          return subParsed;
        }
      }).filter(Boolean);
      processedFormats = processedFormats.concat(subtitleItems);
    }

    processedFormats = processedFormats
      .filter(item => Boolean(item && item.url) && !IGNORED_CONTAINERS.includes(item.ext || ""))
      .filter(item => {
        if (typeof item.url !== "object" || !item.url.audioUrl || !item.url.videoUrl) return true;
        return !processedFormats.some(other =>
          other !== item &&
          typeof other.url === "string" &&
          other.ext === item.ext &&
          other.quality === item.quality &&
          other.type === item.type &&
          other.resolution === item.resolution
        );
      });

    var dedupeSet = new Set();
    processedFormats = processedFormats
      .sort(item => item.ext === "mp4" ? -1 : 1)
      .filter(item => {
        var key = item.quality + "_" + item.resolution + "_" + item.ext;
        if (item.quality && item.quality.toLowerCase().includes("tiny")) return false;
        dedupeSet.add(key);
        return true;
      });

    checkDashSupport(dashMap).then(dashResults => {
      if (dashResults && dashResults.length) {
        dashResults.forEach(item => {
          if (item.resolution) {
            item.sortValues = item.sortValues || {};
            var qDef = mediaConstants.r[item.resolution];
            item.sortValues.qualityValue = qDef ? qDef.value : null;
          }
        });
        processedFormats = dashResults;
        if (!processedFormats.some(item => (item ? item.ext : void 0) === "yt_srt")) {
          processedFormats = processedFormats.concat(subtitleItems);
        }
      }
      resolveFn(processedFormats);
    }).catch(err => {
      console.warn(err);
      resolveFn(processedFormats);
    });
  }

  function extractSubtitles(metadata, preferredLangs) {
    var playerResponse = metadata.player_response;
    if (!playerResponse) return null;
    var parsedResponse;
    try {
      parsedResponse = typeof playerResponse === "object" && playerResponse.captions ? playerResponse : JSON.parse(playerResponse);
    } catch (err) {
      return null;
    }
    var captionTracks;
    try {
      captionTracks = parsedResponse.captions.playerCaptionsTracklistRenderer.captionTracks;
    } catch (err) {
      return null;
    }
    if (!captionTracks || !captionTracks.length) return null;

    var matchedTracks = captionTracks.filter(track => preferredLangs.includes(track.languageCode));
    var resultMap = {};
    var languageList = [];

    matchedTracks.forEach(track => {
      var langCode = track.languageCode;
      var langLabel = Object(cryptoUtils.i18n)("subtitles_lang_" + langCode.replace(/-/g, "_")) || langCode.toUpperCase();
      var trackUrl;
      try {
        trackUrl = new URL(track.baseUrl);
      } catch (err) {
        trackUrl = new URL("https://www.youtube.com" + track.baseUrl);
      }
      if (!featureFlags.a.SRT_V3_SUPPORT && trackUrl.searchParams.get("fmt") === "srv3") {
        trackUrl.searchParams.delete("fmt");
      }
      track.baseUrl = trackUrl.href;
      if (track.vssId !== "a." + langCode) {
        resultMap[langLabel] = trackUrl.href;
        languageList.push(langCode);
      }
    });

    if (matchedTracks.length > 0) {
      ["en", "vi"].forEach(targetLang => {
        if (!languageList.includes(targetLang)) {
          var fallbackLabel = Object(cryptoUtils.i18n)("subtitles_lang_" + targetLang);
          var translationUrl = matchedTracks[0].baseUrl + "&tlang=" + targetLang;
          resultMap[fallbackLabel] = translationUrl;
        }
      });
    }

    return resultMap;
  }

  var dashRetryTimeout = null;
  var dashRetryCount = 1;

  function fetchDashUrl(targetUrl) {
    return asyncRunner(this, void 0, void 0, regeneratorCore().m(function generatorFn() {
      var sendResult;
      return regeneratorCore().w(function iteratorStep(stepState) {
        for (;;) switch (stepState.n) {
          case 0:
            stepState.n = 1;
            return Object(cryptoUtils.sendMessage)({ type: mediaConstants.b.GET_URL, params: { url: targetUrl } });
          case 1:
            sendResult = stepState.v;
            if (sendResult) {
              stepState.n = 4;
              break;
            }
            if (dashRetryCount === 5) {
              stepState.n = 2;
              break;
            }
            dashRetryTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
              dashRetryCount++;
              EE.emit("widget.updateMedia");
            }, 1000);
            return stepState.a(2, []);
          case 2:
            clearTimeout(dashRetryTimeout);
            return stepState.a(2, []);
          case 3:
            stepState.n = 5;
            break;
          case 4:
            clearTimeout(dashRetryTimeout);
            return stepState.a(2, sendResult.url);
          case 5:
            return stepState.a(2);
        }
      }, generatorFn);
    }));
  }

  exports.a = {
    parse: (targetUrl, options) =>
      asyncRunner(this, void 0, void 0, regeneratorCore().m(function generatorFn() {
        var formatList, fastVideoList, fastResolutionList, audioList, mappedItems, bestAudio, parseErr;
        return regeneratorCore().w(function iteratorStep(stepState) {
          for (;;) switch (stepState.p = stepState.n) {
            case 0:
              stepState.p = 0;
              stepState.n = 1;
              return fetchAndProcessMetadata(targetUrl, options);
            case 1:
              formatList = stepState.v;
              if (formatList[0].ext === "m3u8") {
                return stepState.a(2, formatList);
              }
              fastVideoList = [];
              fastResolutionList = [];
              audioList = [];

              mappedItems = formatList.map(item => {
                if (typeof item.url === "object" && item.url.videoUrl.includes("ratebypass=yes")) {
                  if (item.sortValues && item.sortValues.qualityValue) {
                    item.oldResolution = item.resolution;
                    item.resolution = item.resolution + " ";
                    item.sortValues.qualityValue++;
                    fastResolutionList.push(item.resolution);
                    item.fast = true;
                    fastVideoList.push(item);
                  }
                  if (item.audioQuality) {
                    item.url = item.url.videoUrl;
                    try {
                      var audioQualMap = {
                        AUDIO_QUALITY_LOW: { resolution: "128kbps", quality: "medium", i18n_quality: Object(cryptoUtils.i18n)("ql_medium") },
                        AUDIO_QUALITY_MEDIUM: { resolution: "128kbps", quality: "medium", i18n_quality: Object(cryptoUtils.i18n)("ql_medium") },
                        AUDIO_QUALITY_HIGH: { resolution: "256kbps", quality: "high", i18n_quality: Object(cryptoUtils.i18n)("ql_high") }
                      };
                      var chosenAudio = audioQualMap[item.audioQuality];
                      var audioClone = Object.assign({}, item, {
                        ext: "mp3",
                        exts: ["mp3"],
                        type: "audio",
                        soundOnly: true,
                        ignoreSize: true,
                        quality: chosenAudio.quality,
                        i18n_quality: chosenAudio.i18n_quality,
                        resolution: "",
                        fast: true
                      });
                      if (audioClone.sortValues && audioClone.sortValues.qualityValue) {
                        audioClone.sortValues.qualityValue++;
                      }

                    }

                }
                fastVideoList.push(bestAudio);
              }
              return stepState.a(2, fastVideoList);
            case 2:
              stepState.p = 2;
              parseErr = stepState.v;

            mediaObject.exts = ["mp4"];

// Module 12 [detector] - Savior DOM Query, Mutation, and Shadow DOM Utilities
export default function(module, exports, require) {
  "use strict";

  require.d(exports, "c", () => createSaviorHostElement);
  require.d(exports, "l", () => isValidImageElement);
  require.d(exports, "k", () => extractImageDimensions);
  require.d(exports, "g", () => isCaptchaElement);
  require.d(exports, "j", () => isInsideDocument);
  require.d(exports, "h", () => isFullscreenActive);
  require.d(exports, "p", () => applyInlineStyles);
  require.d(exports, "o", () => parseInlineStyleString);
  require.d(exports, "e", () => getElementDimensions);
  require.d(exports, "b", () => attachOpenShadowRoot);
  require.d(exports, "a", () => createDomElement);
  require.d(exports, "d", () => findMediaContainerElement);
  require.d(exports, "m", () => isEligibleMediaElement);
  require.d(exports, "f", () => isBlockedByFilter);
  require.d(exports, "i", () => checkAllowFullscreen);
  require.d(exports, "n", () => checkCustomPlayerAttributes);

  var urlMatcher = require(33);
  var cryptoUtils = require(0);

  function regeneratorCore() {
    /*! regenerator-runtime -- Copyright (c) 2014-present, Facebook, Inc. -- license (MIT): https://github.com/babel/babel/blob/main/packages/babel-helpers/LICENSE */
    (regeneratorCore = function() {
      return { w: wrapFn, m: markFn };
    })();
  }
  function wrapFn(stepFn) { return stepFn; }
  function markFn(genFn) { return genFn; }

  var asyncRunner = function(thisArg, extraArg1, extraArg2, generator) {
    return new (extraArg2 || (extraArg2 = Promise))(function(resolve, reject) {
      function step(result) {
        try {
          advance(generator.next(result));
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      }
      function fail(err) {
        try {
          advance(generator.throw(err));
        } catch (err2) {
          reject(err2);
        }
      }
      function advance(stepResult) {
        var val;
        if (stepResult.done) {
          resolve(stepResult.value);
        } else {
          val = stepResult.value;
          (val instanceof extraArg2 ? val : new extraArg2(function(res) { res(val); })).then(step, fail);
        }
      }
      advance((generator = generator.apply(thisArg, extraArg1 || [])).next());
    });
  };

  function getElementDimensions(targetElement) {
    var parentNode;
    if (!(targetElement instanceof HTMLElement)) return { width: 0, height: 0 };
    if (targetElement.matches("embed") && ((parentNode = targetElement.parentNode) === null || parentNode === void 0 ? void 0 : parentNode.matches("object"))) {
      targetElement = targetElement.parentNode;
    }
    var innerEmbed = targetElement === null || targetElement === void 0 ? void 0 : targetElement.querySelector("embed");
    if (innerEmbed && innerEmbed.offsetWidth && innerEmbed.offsetHeight) {
      targetElement = innerEmbed;
    }
    return { width: targetElement.offsetWidth, height: targetElement.offsetHeight };
  }

  function parseInlineStyleString(styleString) {
    return styleString.split(";").reduce((styleMap, stylePair) => {
      var colonIndex = stylePair.indexOf(":");
      if (colonIndex !== -1) {
        var propKey = stylePair.substr(0, colonIndex).trim();
        var propValue = stylePair.substr(colonIndex + 1).trim();
        styleMap[propKey] = propValue;
      }
      return styleMap;
    }, {});
  }

  function applyInlineStyles(targetElements, styleMap) {
    var applySingleElement = elementNode => {
      var existingStyle = elementNode.getAttribute("style") || "";
      var parsedMap = parseInlineStyleString(existingStyle);
      for (var styleKey in styleMap) {
        if (styleMap.hasOwnProperty(styleKey)) {
          parsedMap[styleKey] = styleMap[styleKey];
        }
      }
      var newStyleString = Object.keys(parsedMap).map(keyName => keyName + ": " + parsedMap[keyName]).join("; ") + ";";
      if (existingStyle !== newStyleString) {
        elementNode.setAttribute("style", newStyleString);
      }
    };
    if (Array.isArray(targetElements)) {
      targetElements.forEach(applySingleElement);
    } else {
      applySingleElement(targetElements);
    }
  }

  function attachOpenShadowRoot(hostElement) {
    return hostElement.attachShadow
      ? hostElement.attachShadow({ mode: "open" })
      : hostElement.createShadowRoot({ mode: "open" });
  }

  function createSaviorHostElement() {
    var hostStyles = Object.entries({
      all: "unset",
      position: "absolute",
      top: "0",
      left: "0",
      "z-index": "99999999999999",
      display: "block !important",
      overflow: "unset"
    }).map(entry => entry[0] + ": " + entry[1]).join("; ");

    return (new DOMParser)
      .parseFromString('<savior-host style="' + hostStyles + '"></savior-host>', "text/html")
      .querySelector("savior-host");
  }

  function createDomElement(tagName, className) {
    var createdElement = document.createElement(tagName);
    if (className) {
      createdElement.className = className;
    }
    return createdElement;
  }

  function findMediaContainerElement(targetElement) {
    if (!targetElement) return targetElement;
    if (targetElement.tagName === "IFRAME") return targetElement;
    if (targetElement.tagName === "IMG") return targetElement;

    var matchedElement = targetElement;
    if (typeof targetElement.getBoundingClientRect !== "function") return matchedElement;

    var childRect = targetElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!childRect || (childRect.width === 0 && childRect.height === 0)) {
      return matchedElement;
    }

    var childCenterX = childRect.left + childRect.width / 2;
    var childCenterY = childRect.top + childRect.height / 2;
    var depth = 0;
    var maxDepth = 10;

    for (var parentElement = targetElement.parentElement; parentElement && parentElement.parentElement && parentElement.tagName !== "BODY" && depth < maxDepth;) {
      depth++;
      if (typeof parentElement.getBoundingClientRect === "function") {
        var parentRect = parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (parentRect) {
          var sizeMatch = Math.abs(parentRect.width - childRect.width) < 3 && Math.abs(parentRect.height - childRect.height) < 3;
          var posOverlap = (
            childRect.height > parentRect.height ||
            childRect.width > parentRect.width ||
            (Math.abs(childCenterY - parentRect.top - parentRect.height / 2) < 3 &&
              Math.abs(childCenterX - parentRect.left - parentRect.width / 2) < 3)
          );
          if (posOverlap && sizeMatch) {
            matchedElement = parentElement;
          }
        }
      }
      parentElement = parentElement.parentElement;
    }

    return matchedElement;
  }

  function isEligibleMediaElement(targetElement) {
    return checkAllowFullscreen(targetElement) && checkCustomPlayerAttributes(targetElement) && !isBlockedByFilter(targetElement);
  }

  function checkAllowFullscreen(targetElement) {
    if (targetElement.tagName.toLowerCase() === "audio") return true;
    if (urlMatcher.a.checkWhite(targetElement, "pip-allowfullscreen-false")) return true;
    if (targetElement.matches('embed[allowfullscreen="true"], iframe[allowfullscreen], iframe[allow*="fullscreen"], video') &&
        !urlMatcher.a.check(targetElement, "pip-allowfullscreen-false")) {
      return true;
    }
    if (targetElement.tagName === "OBJECT") {
      var paramElements = Object(cryptoUtils.queryAll)('param[value="true"]', targetElement);
      return Boolean(paramElements.filter(paramNode => {
        var paramName = paramNode.getAttribute("name");
        return (paramName === null || paramName === void 0 ? void 0 : paramName.toLowerCase()) === "allowfullscreen";
      }).length);
    }
    var mediaSrc = targetElement.src;
    return Boolean(
      targetElement.offsetParent &&
      mediaSrc &&
      (mediaSrc.includes("vidio.com/embed") ||
        mediaSrc.match(/detik\.com\/(?:.*\/)?embed/i) ||
        mediaSrc.match(/play\.play[\s\S]*(xyz|net)/i) ||
        mediaSrc.includes("vuighe.net/embed/?url") ||
        (mediaSrc && mediaSrc.match(/url=+[\s\S]+(video.docbao.vn)+[\s\S]+(.mp4)/g)) ||
        mediaSrc.match(/drive\.google\.com\/file\/.*\/preview/))
    );
  }

  function checkCustomPlayerAttributes(targetElement) {
    if (["v.douyu.com", "www.twitch.tv"].includes(location.host)) return true;
    var srcAttribute = targetElement.getAttribute("src");
    if (targetElement.tagName.toLowerCase() === "video") {
      return Boolean((srcAttribute && srcAttribute !== "blob:null") || targetElement.querySelector("source"));
    }
    if (targetElement.tagName.toLowerCase() !== "iframe") return false;
    return !location.href.includes(srcAttribute);
  }

  function isBlockedByFilter(targetElement) {
    var isBlocked = false;
    var embedChild = targetElement.querySelector("embed");
    if (embedChild) {
      isBlocked = urlMatcher.a.check(embedChild);
    }
    return isBlocked || urlMatcher.a.check(targetElement);
  }

  function isValidImageElement(targetElement) {
    return Boolean(targetElement && targetElement.tagName && targetElement.tagName.toLowerCase() === "img" && targetElement.src);
  }

  function extractImageDimensions(imageNode) {
    var queryHelper;
    return asyncRunner(this, void 0, void 0, regeneratorCore().m(function generatorFn() {
      var imgElement, naturalW, naturalH, renderH, renderW, decodeErr;
      return regeneratorCore().w(function iteratorStep(stepState) {
        for (;;) switch (stepState.p = stepState.n) {
          case 0:
            if ((imgElement = imageNode instanceof HTMLImageElement ? imageNode : (queryHelper = imageNode.querySelector) === null || queryHelper === void 0 ? void 0 : queryHelper.call(imageNode, "img"))) {
              stepState.n = 1;
              break;
            }
            return stepState.a(2, true);
          case 1:
            if ((naturalW = imgElement.naturalWidth || 0, naturalH = imgElement.naturalHeight || 0, !(naturalW * naturalH > 0))) {
              stepState.n = 2;
              break;
            }
            return stepState.a(2, naturalW * naturalH < cryptoUtils.MIN_IMAGE_TOTAL_PIXEL);
          case 2:
            if ((renderH = imgElement.height || 0, renderW = imgElement.width || 0, !(renderH * renderW > 0))) {
              stepState.n = 3;
              break;
            }
            return stepState.a(2, renderH * renderW < cryptoUtils.MIN_IMAGE_TOTAL_PIXEL);
          case 3:
            if (imgElement.complete) {
              stepState.n = 7;
              break;
            }
            return stepState.p = 4, stepState.n = 5, imgElement.decode();
          case 5:
            stepState.n = 7;
            break;
          case 6:
            stepState.p = 6, decodeErr = stepState.v, console.debug("Image decode error:", decodeErr);
          case 7:
            if (imgElement.naturalWidth && imgElement.naturalHeight) {
              stepState.n = 8;
              break;
            }
            return stepState.a(2, true);
          case 8:
            return stepState.a(2, imgElement.naturalWidth * imgElement.naturalHeight < cryptoUtils.MIN_IMAGE_TOTAL_PIXEL);
        }
      }, generatorFn, null, [[4, 6]]);
    }));
  }

  function isCaptchaElement(targetElement) {
    var captchaSelectors = [
      '[src*="captcha" i]',
      '[srcset*="captcha" i]',
      '[alt*="captcha" i]',
      '[title*="captcha" i]',
      '[id*="captcha" i]',
      '[class*="captcha" i]',
      '[name*="captcha" i]',
      '[aria-label*="captcha" i]',
      '[data-src*="captcha" i]',
      '[data-original*="captcha" i]',
      '[src*="geetest" i]',
      '[class*="geetest" i]',
      '[id*="kaptcha" i]',
      '[src*="kaptcha" i]',
      '[class*="turnstile" i]',
      '[src*="arkose" i]',
      ".g-recaptcha",
      ".h-captcha",
      ".cf-turnstile"
    ].join(",");
    return Boolean(targetElement && targetElement.matches && targetElement.matches(captchaSelectors));
  }

  function isInsideDocument(targetElement) {
    var rootParent = document.body.parentNode ? document.body.parentNode.parentNode : void 0;
    for (var current = targetElement; current && current.nodeName !== "#document" && current !== rootParent && current.nodeName !== "#document-fragment";) {
      var computed = window.getComputedStyle(current);
      if (computed && computed.getPropertyValue("position") === "fixed") {
        return true;
      }
      current = current.parentNode;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function isFullscreenActive() {
    return Boolean(document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement);
  }
}

<file path="src/content/detector/feature-flags.js">
// Module 11 [detector] - Savior Feature Flags and Browser Capability Detector
export default function(module, exports, require) {
  "use strict";

  (function(globalContext) {
    var mediaConstants = require(1);

    function parseVersionSegments(versionString) {
      return versionString.split(".").map(part => parseInt(part, 10));
    }

    function compareBrowserVersion(currentVersion, versionExpression) {
      if (!currentVersion) return false;
      var tokens = versionExpression.split(" ");
      if (tokens.length !== 2) return false;

      var threshold = -1;
      switch (tokens[0]) {
        case ">":
          threshold = 1;
          break;
        case ">=":
          threshold = 0;
          break;
      }

      var targetVersion = parseVersionSegments(tokens[1]);
      var diff = currentVersion[0] - targetVersion[0];
      if (diff !== 0) return diff >= threshold;
      diff = currentVersion[1] - targetVersion[1];
      if (diff !== 0) return diff >= threshold;
      diff = currentVersion[2] - targetVersion[2];
      if (diff !== 0) return diff >= threshold;
      diff = currentVersion[3] - targetVersion[3];
      return diff >= threshold;
    }

    var detectFeatureFlags = function(userAgent) {
      var chromeMatch = userAgent.match(/Chrome\/([\d.]+)/);
      var chromeVersion = chromeMatch && chromeMatch[1] ? parseVersionSegments(chromeMatch[1]) : null;
      var satisfies = compareBrowserVersion.bind(null, chromeVersion);

      return {
        YT: {
          mp4: true,
          m4a: true,
          webm: satisfies(">= 39.0.2171.103"),
          weba: satisfies(">= 39.0.2171.103")
        },
        M3U8: satisfies("> 62.4.3202.180"),
        SOUND_ONLY: satisfies("> 55.4.2883.114") || (Boolean(chromeVersion) && chromeVersion[0] === 50 && satisfies("> 50.3.2661.150")),
        SUBTITLES: satisfies("> 55.4.2883.114") || (Boolean(chromeVersion) && chromeVersion[0] === 50 && satisfies("> 50.3.2661.150")),
        PLAY_NOW_BOTTOM_TOOLTIP: satisfies("> 55.4.2883.126"),
        IS_ADS_PIP_PARAMS: satisfies("> 60.4.3112.120"),
        MEDIA_WEB_REQUEST: satisfies(">= 58.4.3029.118"),
        SERP_ADD_STRUCTURES: satisfies(">= 62.4.3202.176"),
        SERP_ADD_INNER_STRUCTURES: satisfies(">= 64.4.3282.200"),
        MOBILE_TRANSFER_PANEL: true,
        CUSTOM_METRICS_JSON: satisfies(">= 64.4.3282.236"),
        DASH_DOWNLOAD: satisfies(">= 72.0.3626.130"),
        WEB_REQUEST_EXTRA_HEADERS: satisfies(">= 72.0.0.0"),
        NATIVE_PIP: satisfies(">= 74.0.0.0"),
        DOWNLOAD: {
          EXTRA_DATAS: satisfies(">= 103.0.0.0"),
          M3U8_AUDIO: satisfies(">= 109.0.0.0")
        },
        CHATGPT: satisfies(">= 110.0.0.0"),
        DO_NOT_ONBOARD_YOUTUBE_ANTI_ADBLOCKER: satisfies(">= 117.0.0.0"),
        DO_NOT_FAST_FORWARD_YOUTUBE_ADS: satisfies(">= " + mediaConstants.e),
        SRT_V3_SUPPORT: satisfies(">= 121.0.0.0"),
        ADGUARD_SWITCHER: satisfies(">= 140.0.0.0"),
        PREFETCH_SUPPORT: satisfies(">= 110.0.0.0"),
        NEW_MEDIA_DOWNLOAD: satisfies(">= 151.0.0.0")
      };
    };

    var featureFlags = detectFeatureFlags(globalContext.navigator.userAgent);
    exports.a = featureFlags;
  }).call(this, require(13));
}

<file path="src/content/detector/filename-sanitizer.js">
// Module 80 [detector] - Savior Filename and Media Title Sanitizer
export default function(module, exports, require) {
  "use strict";

  function countDigits(inputString) {
    var digitMatches = inputString.match(/\d/g);
    return digitMatches ? digitMatches.length : 0;
  }

  function countLetters(inputString) {
    var letterMatches = inputString.match(/[A-Za-z]/g);
    return letterMatches ? letterMatches.length : 0;
  }

  function cleanMovieTitleKeywords(rawTitle) {
    return rawTitle
      .replace(/xem|phim|clips?|videos?|online/gi, "")
      .replace(/^\s?-\s?/gi, "")
      .trim();
  }

  function sanitizeMediaTitle(candidateTitle, fallbackTitle) {
    var clipElement, headingElement;
    var resolvedFallback = fallbackTitle !== undefined ? fallbackTitle : document.title;

    if (typeof candidateTitle !== "string" || typeof resolvedFallback !== "string") {
      return candidateTitle;
    }

    var vietMovieHostPattern = /(vkool)|(vphimzz\.net)|(thichxemphim\.net)|(video\.vietnam\.vn)/i;
    if (document.location.host.match(vietMovieHostPattern)) {
      return document.title ? document.title.replace(/Xem Phim /i, "") : candidateTitle;
    }

    if (location.host.includes("hhkungfu.tv")) {
      var clickedEpisodeButton = document.querySelector(".button_movie_clicked");
      return document.title && clickedEpisodeButton
        ? document.title.replace(/\d+/, clickedEpisodeButton.innerText || "")
        : document.title;
    }

    if (candidateTitle === "videoplayback" || candidateTitle === "video") {
      return cleanMovieTitleKeywords(resolvedFallback);
    }

    if (document.location.host === "tv.naver.com" && candidateTitle === "content") {
      candidateTitle =
        (null === (clipElement = document.getElementsByClassName("_clipTitle")[0]) || clipElement === void 0
          ? void 0
          : clipElement.title) ||
        (null === (headingElement = document.querySelector("h2")) || headingElement === void 0
          ? void 0
          : headingElement.textContent) ||
        document.title;
    }

    if (document.location.host === "m.naver.com" && candidateTitle.length > 5) {
      return candidateTitle;
    }

    if (document.location.host === "keeng.vn" && resolvedFallback.includes("Album")) {
      candidateTitle = document.getElementsByClassName("song_active")[0].children[0].title;
    }

    if (document.location.host === "www.facebook.com") {
      resolvedFallback = resolvedFallback.replace(/^\([0-9]+\)\s/, "");
    }

    var strippedTitle = candidateTitle.replace(/[\W+_]/g, "");
    var strippedLength = strippedTitle.length;
    var numDigits = countDigits(strippedTitle);
    var numLetters = countLetters(strippedTitle);
    var digitRatio = strippedLength ? numDigits / strippedLength : 0;
    var letterRatio = strippedLength ? numLetters / strippedLength : 0;

    if (0.99 > digitRatio + letterRatio) {
      return resolvedFallback;
    }
    if (digitRatio >= 0.5) {
      return cleanMovieTitleKeywords(resolvedFallback);
    }
    return candidateTitle;
  }

  exports.a = sanitizeMediaTitle;
}
