<file path="src/content/detector/dom-scanner.js">
// Module 176 [detector] - Savior DOM Scanner and Mutation Observer
export default function(module, exports, require) {
  "use strict";

  require.d(exports, "b", () => getVideoTimeInFrame);
  require.d(exports, "a", () => initDomScanner);

  var utils = require(0);
  var providerRegistry = require(92);
  var domHelper = require(12);
  var metricsLogger = require(5);
  var mediaConstants = require(1);
  var layoutConstants = require(21);
  var settingsManager = require(7);

  async function logFastForwardStatus(eventType, offMessage, onMessage) {
    const isFastForward = await utils.sendMessage({ type: mediaConstants.b.GET_FASTFORWARD_ENABLED });
    metricsLogger.a.log(eventType, isFastForward ? onMessage : offMessage);
  }

  async function getAdblockStatus() {
    const adblockStatus = await utils.sendMessage({ type: mediaConstants.b.GET_ADBLOCK_STATUS });
    if (adblockStatus?.isAdblockTurnedOff) {
      return "none";
    }
    const storageData = await chrome.storage.local.get("adguardInfo");
    const adguardInfo = storageData.adguardInfo || {};
    const isAutoOff = adblockStatus?.isAdblockAutoOff || adblockStatus;
    if (!isAutoOff) {
      return "adblock";
    }
    if (isAutoOff && !adguardInfo.isAdguardEnabled) {
      return "adguard";
    }
    return "none";
  }

  async function logAdblockStatus(eventType, normalMessage, adguardMessage, disableAdguard, isWall) {
    const adblockStatus = await utils.sendMessage({ type: mediaConstants.b.GET_ADBLOCK_STATUS });
    if (adblockStatus?.isAdblockTurnedOff) {
      metricsLogger.a.log(
        eventType,
        isWall ? metricsLogger.a.YOUTUBE_ERROR_WALL_BY_SAVIOR : metricsLogger.a.YOUTUBE_ERROR_POPUP_BY_SAVIOR
      );
      return;
    }
    const storageData = await chrome.storage.local.get("adguardInfo");
    const adguardInfo = storageData.adguardInfo || {};
    const isAutoOff = adblockStatus?.isAdblockAutoOff || adblockStatus;
    if (!isAutoOff || adguardInfo.isAdguardEnabled) {
      metricsLogger.a.log(
        eventType,
        isWall ? metricsLogger.a.YOUTUBE_ERROR_WALL_BY_SAVIOR : metricsLogger.a.YOUTUBE_ERROR_POPUP_BY_SAVIOR
      );
      return;
    }
    metricsLogger.a.log(eventType, isAutoOff && adguardInfo.isAdguardEnabled ? adguardMessage : normalMessage);
    if (disableAdguard) {
      chrome.storage.local.set({
        adguardInfo: Object.assign(Object.assign({}, adguardInfo), { isAdguardEnabled: false })
      }).then(() => {
        metricsLogger.a.log(mediaConstants.t, metricsLogger.a.YOUTUBE_ADGUARD_OFF);
        location.reload();
      });
    }
  }

  function getVideoTimeInFrame(rootElement, targetElement) {
    var container = rootElement || document;
    try {
      var videoElement = container.querySelector("video");
      if (targetElement) {
        videoElement = targetElement instanceof HTMLVideoElement ? targetElement : null;
      }
      if (!videoElement) throw new Error();
      if (videoElement.paused) {
        videoElement.addEventListener("playing", () => {
          setTimeout(() => {
            utils.sendMessage({ type: mediaConstants.b.EVENTENOUGHTIME });
          }, 10000);
        }, { once: true });
      } else {
        setTimeout(() => {
          utils.sendMessage({ type: mediaConstants.b.EVENTENOUGHTIME });
        }, 10000);
      }
    } catch (ignoreError) {
      var iframeElement = container.querySelector("iframe");
      if (targetElement) {
        iframeElement = targetElement instanceof HTMLIFrameElement ? targetElement : null;
      }
      if (!iframeElement) return;
      utils.sendMessage({
        type: mediaConstants.b.GETVIDTIME,
        params: { url: iframeElement?.src }
      });
    }
  }

  function initDomScanner() {
    var MutationObserverClass = window.MutationObserver || window.WebKitMutationObserver;
    var defaultMediaTags = ["video", "iframe", "audio", "embed", "object"];
    var dynamicMediaTags = [];

    var scannerInstance = {
      siteData: null,
      _observer: null,
      _imageObserver: null,
      mediaTags: [...defaultMediaTags],
      currentHref: "",
      timeoutAdsBlock: null,
      youtubeAdsContainerClasses:
        (settingsManager.a.get("ADLIST_CUSTOM_RULE").youtube_logic || {})[mediaConstants.u] ||
        layoutConstants.i.join(","),
      youtubeSkipBtnClasses:
        (settingsManager.a.get("ADLIST_CUSTOM_RULE").youtube_logic || {})[mediaConstants.y] ||
        layoutConstants.j.join(","),
      downloadImageAbTest: null,

      load() {
        this.siteData = providerRegistry.getSiteData(location.host);
        var additionalNodes = (this.siteData?.addNode?.call(this.siteData)) || [];
        this.mediaTags.push(...additionalNodes);
        dynamicMediaTags.push(...additionalNodes);
        var initialMediaNodes = utils.queryAll(this.mediaTags.join(", "));
        this._observer = new MutationObserverClass(this.handleDomChanged.bind(this));
        this._observer.observe(document.body, {
          childList: true,
          subtree: true,
          attributeFilter: ["src", "data-src", "hidden", "opened"]
        });
        var customElements = this.siteData?.getCustomElement?.call(this.siteData) ?? [];
        initialMediaNodes.push(...customElements);
        if (initialMediaNodes.length) {
          this.nodeChangedNotifier(initialMediaNodes);
        }
        this.runImageDetection();
        if (this.siteData?.onDomScannerInit) {
          this.siteData.onDomScannerInit(this);
        }
      },

      async runImageDetection() {
        if (!this.downloadImageAbTest) {
          this.downloadImageAbTest = utils.sendMessage({
            type: mediaConstants.b.GET_ABTEST,
            testName: "downloadImageAllSites"
          });
        }
        var testResult = await this.downloadImageAbTest;
        if (!testResult.groupName && !this.siteData?.getImageNode) {
          return;
        }
        await utils.sleep(500);
        var imageElements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("img"));
        var processedImages = await Promise.all(
          imageElements.map(async (imageElement) => {
            var candidateNode =
              (this.siteData?.getImageNode?.call(this.siteData, imageElement)) ||
              (domHelper.l(imageElement) ? imageElement : null);
            var validImageNode = candidateNode;
            if (!validImageNode) return null;
            var isCachedOrReady = domHelper.g(candidateNode);
            if (!isCachedOrReady) {
              isCachedOrReady = await domHelper.k(candidateNode);
            }
            validImageNode = isCachedOrReady;
            if (!validImageNode) return null;
            if (candidateNode) {
              candidateNode.setAttribute("savior-scanned-img", location.href);
            }
            return candidateNode;
          })
        );
        var validImages = processedImages.filter(Boolean);
        if (validImages.length) {
          EE.emit("dom-scanner.node-changed", validImages, []);
        }
      },

      _hasPossibleImageMutations(mutationRecords) {
        for (var i = 0; i < mutationRecords.length; i++) {
          var rec = mutationRecords[i];
          if (rec.type === "attributes") {
            var attr = rec.attributeName;
            if (attr === "src" || attr === "data-src" || attr === "srcset") return true;
          } else {
            var target = rec.target;
            if (target && target.tagName === "IMG") return true;
            for (var a = 0; a < rec.addedNodes.length; a++) {
              var an = rec.addedNodes[a];
              if (an.nodeType === 1 && (an.tagName === "IMG" || an.firstElementChild)) return true;
            }
            for (var r = 0; r < rec.removedNodes.length; r++) {
              var rn = rec.removedNodes[r];
              if (rn.nodeType === 1 && (rn.tagName === "IMG" || rn.firstElementChild)) return true;
            }
          }
        }
        return false;
      },

      async imageHandler(mutationRecords) {
        if (!this._hasPossibleImageMutations(mutationRecords)) {
          return;
        }
        if (!this.downloadImageAbTest) {
          this.downloadImageAbTest = utils.sendMessage({
            type: mediaConstants.b.GET_ABTEST,
            testName: "downloadImageAllSites"
          });
        }
        var testResult = await this.downloadImageAbTest;
        if (!testResult.groupName && !this.siteData?.getImageNode) {
          return;
        }
        var addedImages = [];
        var removedImages = [];
        var inspectImageNode = async (domNode) => {
          var candidate =
            (this.siteData?.getImageNode?.call(this.siteData, domNode)) ||
            (domHelper.l(domNode) ? domNode : null);
          var valid = candidate;
          if (!valid) return null;
          var isCached = domHelper.g(candidate);
          if (!isCached) {
            isCached = await domHelper.k(candidate);
          }
          valid = isCached;
          if (!valid) return null;
          return candidate;
        };

        for (var recordIndex = 0; recordIndex < mutationRecords.length; recordIndex++) {
          var record = mutationRecords[recordIndex];
          var inspectedTarget = await inspectImageNode(record.target);
          if (inspectedTarget) {
            if (inspectedTarget.hasAttribute("savior-scanned-img")) {
              removedImages.push(inspectedTarget);
              addedImages.push(inspectedTarget);
            } else {
              inspectedTarget.setAttribute("savior-scanned-img", location.href);
              addedImages.push(inspectedTarget);
            }
          } else {
            record.removedNodes.forEach((removedNode) => {
              if (removedNode instanceof HTMLElement) {
                var matchedImages = removedNode.matches("[savior-scanned-img]")
                  ? [removedNode]
                  : [...removedNode.querySelectorAll("[savior-scanned-img]")];
                removedImages.push(...matchedImages);
              }
            });
            for (var addedIndex = 0; addedIndex < record.addedNodes.length; addedIndex++) {
              var addedNode = record.addedNodes[addedIndex];
              var inspectedAdded = await inspectImageNode(addedNode);
              if (inspectedAdded) {
                inspectedAdded.setAttribute("savior-scanned-img", location.href);
                addedImages.push(inspectedAdded);
              }
            }
          }
        }

        if (addedImages.length || removedImages.length) {
          EE.emit("dom-scanner.node-changed", addedImages, removedImages);
        }
      },

      _hasPossibleMediaMutations(records) {
        if (!records || !records.length) return false;
        var mediaTags = this.mediaTags;
        for (var i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
          var rec = records[i];
          if (rec.type === "attributes") {
            var tag = rec.target?.tagName ? rec.target.tagName.toLowerCase() : "";
            if (mediaTags.includes(tag) || tag === "video" || tag === "audio" || tag === "source") {
              return true;
            }
          } else if (rec.type === "childList") {
            for (var a = 0; a < rec.addedNodes.length; a++) {
              var an = rec.addedNodes[a];
              if (an.nodeType === 1) {
                var atag = an.tagName.toLowerCase();
                if (mediaTags.includes(atag) || atag === "video" || atag === "audio" || atag === "source") {
                  return true;
                }
                if (an.firstElementChild && (an.querySelector("video, audio, embed, object") || (this.siteData?.isValidVideoNode && this.siteData.isValidVideoNode(an)))) {
                  return true;
                }
              }
            }
            for (var r = 0; r < rec.removedNodes.length; r++) {
              var rn = rec.removedNodes[r];
              if (rn.nodeType === 1) {
                var rtag = rn.tagName.toLowerCase();
                if (mediaTags.includes(rtag) || rtag === "video" || rtag === "audio" || rtag === "source") {
                  return true;
                }
                if (rn.firstElementChild && rn.querySelector("video, audio, embed, object")) {
                  return true;
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
        return false;
      },

      videoHandler(mutationRecords) {
        var hasMutations = this._hasPossibleMediaMutations(mutationRecords);
        var addedMedia = [];
        var removedMedia = [];

        var now = Date.now();
        if (!this._lastForceUpdate || now - this._lastForceUpdate > 300) {
          this._lastForceUpdate = now;
          this.siteData?.forceUpdate?.call(this.siteData);
        }

        if (this.siteData?.getCustomElement) {
          var customElements = this.siteData.getCustomElement();
          if (customElements && customElements.length) {
            addedMedia.push(...customElements);
          }
        }

        if (!hasMutations && !addedMedia.length) {
          return;
        }

        var mediaSelector = this._mediaSelector || (this._mediaSelector = this.mediaTags.join(", "));

        mutationRecords.forEach((record) => {
          var targetElement = record.target;
          var targetTag = targetElement.tagName ? targetElement.tagName.toLowerCase() : "";
          if (
            record.type === "attributes" &&
            record.attributeName === "src" &&
            this.mediaTags.includes(targetTag)
          ) {
            removedMedia.push(targetElement);
            addedMedia.push(targetElement);
          } else {
            record.removedNodes.forEach((nodeItem) => {
              var nodeTag = nodeItem.tagName ? nodeItem.tagName.toLowerCase() : "";
              if (nodeTag && this.mediaTags.indexOf(nodeTag) !== -1) {
                removedMedia.push(nodeItem);
              } else {
                if (
                  targetTag === "video" &&
                  !removedMedia.includes(targetElement) &&
                  nodeTag === "source"
                ) {
                  removedMedia.push(targetElement);
                }
                if (nodeItem.firstElementChild) {
                  var nestedMedia = utils.queryAll(mediaSelector, nodeItem);
                  removedMedia.push(...nestedMedia);
                }
              }
            });
            record.addedNodes.forEach((nodeItem) => {
              var nodeTag = nodeItem.tagName ? nodeItem.tagName.toLowerCase() : "";
              if (nodeTag && this.mediaTags.indexOf(nodeTag) !== -1) {
                addedMedia.push(nodeItem);
              } else {
                if (
                  targetTag === "video" &&
                  !addedMedia.includes(targetElement) &&
                  nodeTag === "source"
                ) {
                  addedMedia.push(targetElement);
                }
                if (nodeItem.firstElementChild) {
                  var nestedMedia = utils.queryAll(mediaSelector, nodeItem);
                  addedMedia.push(...nestedMedia);
                }
              }
            });
          }
        });

        if (addedMedia.length || removedMedia.length) {
          this.nodeChangedNotifier(addedMedia, removedMedia);
        }
      },

      logYoutubeAds() {},
      checkAdBlockError() {
        return Promise.resolve();
      },

      handleDomChanged(mutationRecords) {
        if (!this._pendingMutations) {
          this._pendingMutations = [];
        }
        if (this._pendingMutations.length < 500) {
          this._pendingMutations.push(...mutationRecords);
        }
        if (this._domThrottleTimer) return;

        var scheduleFrame = (typeof requestAnimationFrame === "function")
          ? requestAnimationFrame
          : (fn) => setTimeout(fn, 16);

        this._domThrottleTimer = scheduleFrame(() => {
          this._domThrottleTimer = null;
          var records = this._pendingMutations;
          this._pendingMutations = null;
          if (records && records.length) {
            this.videoHandler(records);
            this.imageHandler(records);
          }
        });
      },

      nodeChangedNotifier(addedNodes = [], removedNodes = []) {
        var filteredAdded = addedNodes.filter((elementNode) => {
          if (dynamicMediaTags.some((tagSelector) => elementNode.matches(tagSelector))) {
            return true;
          }
          if (domHelper.f(elementNode)) {
            return false;
          }
          return this.siteData?.isValidVideoNode
            ? this.siteData.isValidVideoNode(elementNode)
            : domHelper.m(elementNode);
        });
        EE.emit("dom-scanner.node-changed", filteredAdded, removedNodes);
      },

      destroy() {
        clearTimeout(this.timeoutAdsBlock);
        if (this._observer) {
          this._observer.disconnect();
          this._observer = null;
        }
        if (this._imageObserver) {
          this._imageObserver.disconnect();
          this._imageObserver = null;
        }
        this.mediaTags = [...defaultMediaTags];
        dynamicMediaTags.length = 0;
      }
    };

    EE.on("dom-scanner.load", () => scannerInstance.load());
    EE.on("dom-scanner.refresh", () => {
      scannerInstance.destroy();
      scannerInstance.load();
    });
    EE.on("dom-scanner.destroy", () => scannerInstance.destroy());
  }

  EE.on("get_vid_time_in_frame", () => {
    getVideoTimeInFrame();
  });
};
</file>

<file path="popup/popup.js">
/**
 * VidManager - Popup Script
 * 2 Main Sections: Download Manager Launcher & Recent Downloads List.
 */

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  const recentMediaList = document.getElementById('recent-media-list');
  const recentEmptyState = document.getElementById('recent-empty-state');
  const recentTotalBadge = document.getElementById('recent-total-badge');
  const btnFooterManager = document.getElementById('btn-footer-manager');
  const toggleOnpageBar = document.getElementById('toggle-onpage-bar');
  const toggleImageBar = document.getElementById('toggle-image-bar');

  // Handle On-Page Toolbar quick toggle (Video)
  if (toggleOnpageBar) {
    if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.local) {
      chrome.storage.local.get(['on_page_buttons', 'onPageButtonsEnabled'], (data) => {
        const isEnabled = data.on_page_buttons !== undefined ? data.on_page_buttons : data.onPageButtonsEnabled;
        toggleOnpageBar.checked = (isEnabled !== false);
      });
    }

    toggleOnpageBar.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const isEnabled = toggleOnpageBar.checked;
      if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.local) {
        chrome.storage.local.set({
          on_page_buttons: isEnabled,
          onPageButtonsEnabled: isEnabled
        }, () => {
          showToast(isEnabled ? 'Đã bật thanh tải trên video' : 'Đã tắt thanh tải trên video');
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // Handle On-Page Toolbar quick toggle (Images)
  if (toggleImageBar) {
    if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.local) {
      chrome.storage.local.get(['image_download_enabled', 'imageDownloadEnabled'], (data) => {
        const isEnabled = data.image_download_enabled !== undefined ? data.image_download_enabled : data.imageDownloadEnabled;
        toggleImageBar.checked = (isEnabled !== false);
      });
    }

    toggleImageBar.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const isEnabled = toggleImageBar.checked;
      if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.local) {
        chrome.storage.local.set({
          image_download_enabled: isEnabled,
          imageDownloadEnabled: isEnabled
        }, () => {
          showToast(isEnabled ? 'Đã bật nút tải trên ảnh' : 'Đã tắt nút tải trên ảnh');
        });
      }
    });
  }

  const recentlyDeletedIds = new Set();

  function showToast(msg) {
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = msg;
    toast.style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(() => {
      toast.style.display = 'none';
    }, 2800);
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    if (!str) return '';
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
      .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  }

  function formatBytes(bytes) {
    if (!bytes || isNaN(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    let i = 0;
    let val = bytes;
    while (val >= 1024 && i < units.length - 1) {
      val /= 1024;
      i++;
    }
    return `${val.toFixed(i === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[i]}`;
  }

  function formatTime(ts) {
    if (!ts) return '';
    const d = new Date(ts);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
    const now = new Date();
    const isToday = d.toDateString() === now.toDateString();
    const timeStr = d.toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    if (isToday) return timeStr;
    return `${d.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' })} ${timeStr}`;
  }

  // Open Downloads Manager
  function openDownloadsManager() {
    try {
      chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ action: 'openDownloadsPage' });
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.tabs && chrome.tabs.create) {
          chrome.tabs.create({ url: chrome.runtime.getURL('downloads/downloads.html') });
        }
      } catch (__) {}
    }
  }

  if (btnFooterManager) btnFooterManager.addEventListener('click', openDownloadsManager);

  // Notify background that user opened popup
  try {
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ action: 'popupOpened' });
  } catch (_) {}

  // Load and render recently downloaded videos (fully synchronized with Download Manager)
  // Single-flight wrapper: concurrent triggers (storage change, downloads events,
  // port messages, heartbeat) share one in-flight load; a call that arrives while
  // busy schedules exactly one trailing run. Prevents stale snapshots rendering
  // over fresh ones and collapses progress-write bursts into one reload.
  let _recentLoadInFlight = false;
  let _recentLoadPending = false;
  async function _loadRecentDownloadsImpl() {
    try {
      let historyList = [];
      if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.local) {
        const storageData = await chrome.storage.local.get(['downloadHistory']);
        historyList = (Array.isArray(storageData.downloadHistory) ? storageData.downloadHistory : []).filter(item => {
          if (!item) return false;
          const strId = String(item.id || '');
          const strChromeId = item.chromeId ? String(item.chromeId) : '';
          return !recentlyDeletedIds.has(strId) && (!strChromeId || !recentlyDeletedIds.has(strChromeId));
        });
      }

      // Query active engine tasks
      let activeTaskIds = [];
      try {
        const bgStatus = await new Promise((res) => {
          chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ action: 'getDownloadStatus' }, (r) => {
            if (chrome.runtime?.lastError) return res(null);
            res(r);
          });
        });
        if (bgStatus) {
          if (Array.isArray(bgStatus.activeTaskIds)) {
            activeTaskIds = bgStatus.activeTaskIds.map(String);
          } else if (Array.isArray(bgStatus.activeDownloads)) {
            activeTaskIds = bgStatus.activeDownloads.map(t => String(t.id));
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      // Only query browser downloads that were created by Savior
      const managedChromeIds = new Set(historyList
        .filter(item => item && (item.chromeId || item.isBrowserDownload))
        .map(item => String(item.chromeId || item.id)));

      let chromeDownloads = [];
      try {
        if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.downloads && chrome.downloads.search) {
          const rawDownloads = await chrome.downloads.search({ orderBy: ['-startTime'], limit: 50 });
          const myExtId = (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.runtime && chrome.runtime.id) ? chrome.runtime.id : '';
          chromeDownloads = (rawDownloads || []).filter(cd => {
            const strId = String(cd.id);
            if (recentlyDeletedIds.has(strId)) return false;
            if (managedChromeIds.has(strId)) return true;
            if (myExtId && cd.byExtensionId === myExtId) return true;
            if (activeTaskIds.includes(strId)) return true;
            return false;
          });
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      const mediaDownloads = chromeDownloads.map(cd => {
        const fn = cd.filename ? cd.filename.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop() : 'download';
        const isAudio = /\.(mp3|m4a|aac|flac|wav)$/i.test(cd.filename || '');
        let state = 'downloading';
        if (cd.state === 'complete') {
          state = 'completed';
        } else if (cd.state === 'interrupted') {
          state = (cd.error === 'USER_CANCELED') ? 'canceled' : 'error';
        }

        const totalBytes = cd.totalBytes > 0 ? cd.totalBytes : cd.fileSize || 0;
        const receivedBytes = cd.bytesReceived || 0;
        const pct = totalBytes > 0 ? `${Math.round((receivedBytes / totalBytes) * 100)}%` : (state === 'completed' ? '100%' : '0%');

        return {
          id: cd.id,
          chromeId: cd.id,
          title: fn,
          filename: cd.filename || '',
          totalSize: totalBytes,
          startTime: cd.startTime ? new Date(cd.startTime).getTime() : Date.now(),
          state,
          percent: pct,
          type: isAudio ? 'audio' : 'video'
        };
      });

      // Merge native history and managed chrome downloads, deduplicating by key
      const mergedMap = new Map();
      const nowTs = Date.now();
      let storageNeedsHealing = false;

      for (const item of historyList) {
        if (!item) continue;
        // Normalize state strings identical to downloads.js
        if (item.state === 'in_progress') item.state = 'downloading';
        if (item.state === 'complete') item.state = 'completed';
        if (item.state === 'interrupted' && item.error !== 'USER_CANCELED') item.state = 'error';
        if (item.state === 'cancelled' || item.error === 'USER_CANCELED') item.state = 'canceled';

        const isFinished = item.percent === '100%' || item.speed === 'Hoàn thành';
        if (isFinished && item.state !== 'canceled' && item.state !== 'deleted' && item.state !== 'error') {
          item.state = 'completed';
        }

        if (item.state === 'downloading') {
          const isAct = activeTaskIds.includes(String(item.id)) || (item.chromeId && activeTaskIds.includes(String(item.chromeId)));
          if (!isAct) {
            if (item.outputFile || item.outputPath || isFinished) {
              item.state = 'completed';
              item.percent = '100%';
              storageNeedsHealing = true;
            } else if (nowTs - (item.startTime || 0) > 300000) {
              item.state = 'error';
              item.errorMessage = 'Bị gián đoạn';
              storageNeedsHealing = true;
            }
          }
        }

        const key = getItemDedupeKey(item);
        if (key && !mergedMap.has(key)) {
          const itemStartTime = Number(item.startTime || item.timestamp || item.endTime) || Date.now();
          mergedMap.set(key, {
            ...item,
            startTime: itemStartTime
          });
        }
      }

      if (storageNeedsHealing) {
        try {
          chrome.storage.local.set({ downloadHistory: historyList.slice(0, 200) });
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      for (const item of mediaDownloads) {
        let key = getItemDedupeKey(item);
        if (item.chromeId) {
          for (const [k, ex] of mergedMap.entries()) {
            if (String(ex.chromeId || '') === String(item.chromeId) || String(ex.id || '') === String(item.chromeId)) {
              key = k;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (key && !mergedMap.has(key)) {
          mergedMap.set(key, item);
        } else if (key && mergedMap.has(key) && item.chromeId) {
          const existing = mergedMap.get(key);
          if (!existing.chromeId) existing.chromeId = item.chromeId;
          if (!existing.filename && item.filename) existing.filename = item.filename;
          if ((!existing.startTime || existing.startTime <= 0) && item.startTime) {
            existing.startTime = item.startTime;
          }
          if (item.state === 'completed' || item.state === 'canceled') {
            existing.state = item.state;
          } else if (item.state === 'deleted' && existing.state !== 'completed') {
            existing.state = 'deleted';
          }
        }
      }

      const oneDayAgo = Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      const recentItems = Array.from(mergedMap.values())
        .filter(item => {
          if (!item) return false;
          if (item.state === 'downloading' || item.state === 'in_progress') return true;
          const itemTime = Number(item.startTime || item.timestamp || item.endTime) || 0;
          return itemTime >= oneDayAgo;
        })
        .sort((a, b) => {
          const tA = Number(a.startTime || a.timestamp || a.endTime) || 0;
          const tB = Number(b.startTime || b.timestamp || b.endTime) || 0;
          return tB - tA;
        });

      if (recentTotalBadge) {
        recentTotalBadge.textContent = `${recentItems.length} tệp`;
      }

      renderRecentDownloads(recentItems);
    } catch (_) {
      renderRecentDownloads([]);
    }
  }

  async function loadRecentDownloads() {
    if (_recentLoadInFlight) {
      _recentLoadPending = true;
      return;
    }
    _recentLoadInFlight = true;
    try {
      await _loadRecentDownloadsImpl();
    } finally {
      _recentLoadInFlight = false;
      if (_recentLoadPending) {
        _recentLoadPending = false;
        loadRecentDownloads();
      }
    }
  }

  function getItemDedupeKey(it) {
    if (!it) return '';
    const idKey = it.id || it.taskId || it.chromeId;
    const urlKey = it.url || it.videoUrl || '';
    const rawFn = it.filename || it.outputFile || it.outputPath || '';
    const baseName = rawFn ? rawFn.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop() : '';
    const title = (it.title || '').trim();
    if (idKey) return String(idKey).toLowerCase();
    if (urlKey) return String(urlKey).toLowerCase();
    return (baseName || title || '').toLowerCase();
  }

  function openRecentFile(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    const targetPath = item.outputPath || item.outputFile || item.filename || '';
    const fn = item.filename || item.outputFile || item.outputPath || item.title || '';
    showToast(`Đang mở: ${item.title || 'tệp'}...`);
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      action: 'openFile',
      id: item.id,
      chromeId: item.chromeId,
      path: targetPath,
      filename: fn,
      title: item.title || ''
    }, (res) => {
      if (chrome.runtime?.lastError) return;
      if (res && res.success) {
        showToast(`Đang phát: ${item.title || 'video'}`);
      } else {
        const isNotFound = res?.fileNotFound || (res?.error && res.error.includes('Không tìm thấy'));
        if (isNotFound && !res?.openedFolder) {
          markItemMissing(item);
        } else {
          showToast(res && res.error ? res.error : `Đang mở: ${item.title || 'video'}`);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function markItemMissing(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    item.state = 'deleted';
    showToast('Tệp không còn trên đĩa. Bấm Thử lại để tải lại.');
    loadRecentDownloads();
  }

  function retryRecentItem(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    const retryTaskId = item.id || Date.now();
    showToast('Đang kết nối tải lại video...');

    item.state = 'downloading';
    item.speed = 'Đang kết nối lại...';
    delete item.error;
    delete item.errorMessage;

    if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.local) {
      chrome.storage.local.get(['downloadHistory'], (res) => {
        const list = Array.isArray(res.downloadHistory) ? res.downloadHistory : [];
        const found = list.find(it => it && (String(it.id) === String(item.id) || String(it.chromeId) === String(item.chromeId)));
        if (found) {
          found.state = 'downloading';
          found.speed = 'Đang kết nối lại...';
          delete found.error;
          delete found.errorMessage;
          chrome.storage.local.set({ downloadHistory: list });
        }
      });
    }

    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      action: 'downloadNative',
      taskId: retryTaskId,
      url: item.url || item.videoUrl,
      videoUrl: item.videoUrl || item.url,
      audioUrl: item.audioUrl || '',
      isYouTubeDash: Boolean(item.isYouTubeDash),
      title: item.title,
      quality: item.quality || (item.type === 'audio' ? 'audio' : 'best'),
      soundOnly: Boolean(item.soundOnly || item.type === 'audio'),
      referer: item.referer || item.pageUrl || item.url,
      pageUrl: item.pageUrl || item.url,
      outputDir: item.outputDir || '',
      duration: item.duration || 0,
      size: item.totalBytes || item.size || 0
    }, () => {
      loadRecentDownloads();
    });
  }

  function openRecentFolder(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    const targetPath = item.outputPath || item.outputFile || item.filename || '';
    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      action: 'showInFolder',
      chromeId: item.chromeId,
      path: targetPath
    });
  }

  function cancelRecentItem(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    const strId = String(item.id || '');
    const strChromeId = item.chromeId ? String(item.chromeId) : '';

    const numChromeId = Number(item.chromeId || item.id);
    if (!isNaN(numChromeId) && numChromeId > 0 && typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.downloads) {
      try {
        chrome.downloads.cancel(numChromeId, () => {});
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      action: 'cancelDownload',
      taskId: strId,
      chromeId: strChromeId
    }, () => {
      if (chrome.runtime?.lastError) return;
      showToast('Đã hủy tải xuống');
      loadRecentDownloads();
    });
  }

  function removeRecentItem(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    const strId = String(item.id || '');
    const strChromeId = item.chromeId ? String(item.chromeId) : '';
    if (strId) recentlyDeletedIds.add(strId);
    if (strChromeId) recentlyDeletedIds.add(strChromeId);

    const numChromeId = Number(item.chromeId || item.id);
    if (!isNaN(numChromeId) && numChromeId > 0 && typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.downloads) {
      try {
        chrome.downloads.cancel(numChromeId, () => {
          try { chrome.downloads.erase({ id: item.chromeId }, () => {}); } catch (_) {}
        });
      } catch (_) {
        try { chrome.downloads.erase({ id: item.chromeId }, () => {}); } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      action: 'removeDownload',
      id: strId,
      chromeId: strChromeId
    }, () => {
      if (chrome.runtime?.lastError) return;
      showToast('Đã xoá khỏi danh sách');
      loadRecentDownloads();
    });
  }

  function renderRecentDownloads(items) {
    if (!recentMediaList) return;
    recentMediaList.innerHTML = '';

    if (!items || items.length === 0) {
      if (recentEmptyState) recentEmptyState.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }

    if (recentEmptyState) recentEmptyState.style.display = 'none';

    // Show up to 15 most recent downloads in popup
    const displayItems = items.slice(0, 15);

    displayItems.forEach((item) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'recent-card';
      card.dataset.taskId = String(item.id || item.chromeId || '');

      const isAudio = item.type === 'audio' || /\.(mp3|m4a|aac|flac|wav)$/i.test(item.filename || item.title || '');
      const isDeleted = item.state === 'deleted' || item.fileMissing;
      const isCanceled = item.state === 'canceled' || item.state === 'cancelled' || item.error === 'USER_CANCELED';
      const isError = item.state === 'error' || (item.state === 'interrupted' && !isCanceled);
      const isPaused = item.state === 'paused';
      const isDownloading = (item.state === 'downloading' || item.state === 'in_progress') && !isCanceled && !isError;
      const isCompleted = (item.state === 'completed' || item.percent === '100%') && !isDeleted && !isCanceled && !isError && !isDownloading;

      if (isDeleted) {
        card.classList.add('recent-card-missing');
      }

      let stateBadge = '';
      if (isDownloading) {
        const speedText = item.speed ? ` • ${item.speed}` : '';
        stateBadge = `<span class="status-badge downloading">Đang tải: ${item.percent || '0%'}${speedText}</span>`;
      } else if (isCompleted) {
        stateBadge = `<span class="status-badge completed">Đã hoàn thành</span>`;
      } else if (isCanceled) {
        stateBadge = `<span class="status-badge canceled">Đã hủy</span>`;
      } else if (isPaused) {
        stateBadge = `<span class="status-badge paused">Tạm dừng</span>`;
      } else if (isDeleted) {
        stateBadge = `<span class="status-badge error" style="background:#fef2f2;color:#ef4444;border-color:#fee2e2;">Đã xóa</span>`;
      } else if (isError) {
        stateBadge = `<span class="status-badge error">Gián đoạn</span>`;
      } else {
        stateBadge = `<span class="status-badge completed">Đã hoàn thành</span>`;
      }

      const sizeStr = item.totalSize ? formatBytes(item.totalSize) : (item.size || '');
      const timeStr = formatTime(item.startTime);

      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="card-top">
          <div class="card-icon">
            ${isAudio ? `
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                <path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"></path>
                <circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"></circle>
                <circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"></circle>
              </svg>
            ` : `
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                <polygon points="23 7 16 12 23 17 23 7"></polygon>
                <rect x="1" y="5" width="15" height="14" rx="2" ry="2"></rect>
              </svg>
            `}
          </div>
          <div class="card-details">
            <span class="card-title" title="${escapeHtml(item.title)}">${escapeHtml(item.title || 'Tệp')}</span>
            <div class="card-meta">
              ${stateBadge}
              ${sizeStr ? `<span>${sizeStr}</span>` : ''}
              ${timeStr ? `<span>${timeStr}</span>` : ''}
            </div>
            ${isDownloading ? `
              <div class="progress-bar-wrap">
                <div class="progress-bar-fill" style="width: ${item.percent || '5%'}"></div>
              </div>
            ` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card-actions">
          ${(isError || isCanceled || isDeleted) ? `
            <button class="btn-card-action retry btn-retry-item" title="Tải lại video này">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                <path d="M23 4v6h-6"></path>
                <path d="M20.49 15a9 9 0 1 1-2.12-9.36L23 10"></path>
              </svg>
              Tải lại
            </button>
          ` : ''}
          ${(isCompleted || isDownloading) ? `
            <button class="btn-card-action btn-open-folder" title="Mở thư mục chứa file">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                <path d="M22 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h5l2 3h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"></path>
              </svg>
              Thư mục
            </button>
          ` : ''}
          <button class="btn-card-action danger btn-remove-item" title="${isDownloading ? 'Hủy tải xuống' : 'Xóa khỏi danh sách'}">
            ${isDownloading ? `
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"></line>
                <line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
              </svg>
              Hủy
            ` : `
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
                <polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"></polyline>
                <path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6m3 0V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path>
              </svg>
              Xóa
            `}
          </button>
        </div>
      `;

      if (isCompleted) {
        card.classList.add('clickable');
        card.setAttribute('title', 'Nhấn để mở tệp tin');
        card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          if (e.target.closest('.card-actions')) return;
          openRecentFile(item);
        });
      }

      const btnRetryItem = card.querySelector('.btn-retry-item');
      if (btnRetryItem) {
        btnRetryItem.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          retryRecentItem(item);
        });
      }

      const btnOpenFolder = card.querySelector('.btn-open-folder');
      if (btnOpenFolder) {
        btnOpenFolder.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          openRecentFolder(item);
        });
      }

      const btnRemoveItem = card.querySelector('.btn-remove-item');
      if (btnRemoveItem) {
        btnRemoveItem.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (isDownloading) {
            if (confirm('Bạn có muốn hủy tải xuống video này không?')) {
              cancelRecentItem(item);
            }
          } else {
            removeRecentItem(item);
          }
        });
      }

      recentMediaList.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  // Initial load
  loadRecentDownloads();

  // Listen for storage changes & background progress messages
  if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.onChanged) {
    chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, areaName) => {
      if (areaName === 'local') {
        if (changes.downloadHistory || changes.customDownloadDir) {
          loadRecentDownloads();
        }
        if (toggleOnpageBar && (changes.on_page_buttons || changes.onPageButtonsEnabled)) {
          const change = changes.on_page_buttons || changes.onPageButtonsEnabled;
          if (change && typeof change.newValue === 'boolean') {
            toggleOnpageBar.checked = change.newValue;
          }
        }
        if (toggleImageBar && (changes.image_download_enabled || changes.imageDownloadEnabled)) {
          const change = changes.image_download_enabled || changes.imageDownloadEnabled;
          if (change && typeof change.newValue === 'boolean') {
            toggleImageBar.checked = change.newValue;
          }
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Listen for browser downloads changes (instant sync when a browser download creates or finishes)
  if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.downloads) {
    if (chrome.downloads.onCreated) {
      chrome.downloads.onCreated.addListener(() => {
        loadRecentDownloads();
      });
    }
    if (chrome.downloads.onChanged) {
      chrome.downloads.onChanged.addListener((delta) => {
        loadRecentDownloads();
        if (delta && delta.state && (delta.state.current === 'complete' || delta.state.current === 'interrupted')) {
          setTimeout(loadRecentDownloads, 80);
          setTimeout(loadRecentDownloads, 300);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.runtime && chrome.runtime.onMessage) {
    chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((msg) => {
      if (!msg) return;
      if (msg.action === 'nativeProgress' && msg.taskId) {
        const card = recentMediaList ? recentMediaList.querySelector(`[data-task-id="${msg.taskId}"]`) : null;
        if (card) {
          const fill = card.querySelector('.progress-bar-fill');
          if (fill && msg.percent) fill.style.width = msg.percent;
          const badge = card.querySelector('.status-badge.downloading');
          if (badge && msg.percent) {
            const speedText = msg.speed ? ` • ${msg.speed}` : '';
            badge.textContent = `Đang tải: ${msg.percent}${speedText}`;
          }
          return;
        }
      }
      if (
        msg.action === 'progress' || msg.action === 'complete' || msg.action === 'error' ||
        msg.action === 'nativeProgress' || msg.action === 'nativeComplete' || msg.action === 'nativeError' ||
        msg.action === 'nativeCanceled' || msg.action === 'openFileFailed' ||
        (msg.action === 'openFileResult' && !msg.success && msg.fileNotFound)
      ) {
        if (msg.action === 'openFileFailed' || (msg.action === 'openFileResult' && !msg.success && msg.fileNotFound)) {
          showToast('Tệp đã bị xóa hoặc di chuyển ngoài ổ đĩa!');
        }
        loadRecentDownloads();
        // Dual-pass reload to eliminate storage write race condition
        if (msg.action === 'complete' || msg.action === 'nativeComplete') {
          setTimeout(loadRecentDownloads, 80);
          setTimeout(loadRecentDownloads, 300);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // Heartbeat sync while active downloads exist
  setInterval(() => {
    if (recentMediaList && recentMediaList.querySelector('.status-badge.downloading')) {
      loadRecentDownloads();
    }
  }, 1000);
});
</file>

<file path="scripts/package_release.js">
/**
 * scripts/package_release.js
 * 
 * Packages the Chrome extension for Chrome Web Store (CWS) release into:
 *   dist/savior-extension-v<version>.zip
 * 
 * Strict Exclusion Rules:
 *  - native/bin/ (ffmpeg.exe, yt-dlp.exe, and any binary executables)
 *  - *.exe, *.bat, *.sh, *.cmd (all executables and shell scripts)
 *  - *.log (e.g. host_activity.log)
 *  - tests/
 *  - docs/
 *  - .superpowers/
 *  - .git*
 *  - dist/
 *  - package*.json
 *  - scripts/
 *  - Orphan root popup.html, popup.js
 * 
 * Verifications:
 *  - Zero executables (.exe, .bat, .sh, .cmd)
 *  - Zero log files (*.log)
 *  - Size well below 15MB limit
 *  - Manifest and critical extension files present
 */

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const zlib = require('zlib');

const ROOT_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const MANIFEST_PATH = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'manifest.json');
const DIST_DIR = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'dist');

// Read extension version from manifest.json
if (!fs.existsSync(MANIFEST_PATH)) {
  console.error('Error: manifest.json not found in project root!');
  process.exit(1);
}

const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(MANIFEST_PATH, 'utf8'));
const version = manifest.version || '3.0.2';
const ZIP_NAME = `savior-extension-v${version}.zip`;
const ZIP_PATH = path.join(DIST_DIR, ZIP_NAME);

// Ensure dist directory exists
if (!fs.existsSync(DIST_DIR)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(DIST_DIR, { recursive: true });
}

// Exclusion rules
const EXCLUDED_DIRS = new Set([
  'src',
  'node_modules',
  'tests',
  'docs',
  '.superpowers',
  '.git',
  '.github',
  'dist',
  'scripts',
  'bin', // matches native/bin
  'core', // experimental Universal Media Core — unwired, excluded from build per release plan
  'native', // native messaging helper ships separately (host.js, installers, manifests)
  '.zcode' // local agent session data
]);

const EXCLUDED_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
  '.exe',
  '.bat',
  '.sh',
  '.cmd',
  '.log'
]);

const EXCLUDED_FILES = new Set([
  'package.json',
  'package-lock.json',
  '.gitignore',
  '.DS_Store',
  'Thumbs.db',
  // Disabled SERP/onboarding stubs (22-byte placeholders, zero references)
  'fb-scrapper.js',
  'gads-scrapper.js',
  'gserp-scrapper.js',
  'yserp-scrapper.js',
  'promote-ccserp.js',
  'onboarding.js',
  // Legacy DNR rule redirecting to a non-existent /app.js — unreferenced
  'rules.json',
  '_sec_scan.js', // dev scratch utility
  'options-banner-with-skip-video.jpg' // banner variant of the removed skip-video feature
]);

function shouldExclude(relPath) {
  const normalized = relPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const segments = normalized.split('/');
  const fileName = segments[segments.length - 1];
  const ext = path.extname(fileName).toLowerCase();

  // Specifically exclude orphan root popup files
  if (normalized === 'popup.html' || normalized === 'popup.js') {
    return true;
  }

  // Check excluded directory names in path
  for (const seg of segments.slice(0, -1)) {
    if (EXCLUDED_DIRS.has(seg)) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  // Check specifically native/bin
  if (normalized.startsWith('native/bin/') || normalized === 'native/bin') {
    return true;
  }

  // Check excluded extensions
  if (EXCLUDED_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
    return true;
  }

  // Check excluded exact filenames
  if (EXCLUDED_FILES.has(fileName)) {
    return true;
  }

  // Check package*.json pattern
  if (/^package.*\.json$/i.test(fileName)) {
    return true;
  }

  // Check git files
  if (fileName.startsWith('.git')) {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

function collectFiles(dir, baseDir = ROOT_DIR) {
  let fileList = [];
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    const relPath = path.relative(baseDir, fullPath);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      const normalizedRel = relPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
      const dirName = entry.name;
      if (EXCLUDED_DIRS.has(dirName) || normalizedRel === 'native/bin') {
        continue;
      }
      fileList = fileList.concat(collectFiles(fullPath, baseDir));
    } else if (entry.isFile()) {
      if (!shouldExclude(relPath)) {
        fileList.push({
          fullPath,
          relPath: relPath.replace(/\\/g, '/')
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return fileList;
}

function dosDateTime(d = new Date()) {
  const year = d.getFullYear();
  const month = d.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = d.getDate();
  const hours = d.getHours();
  const minutes = d.getMinutes();
  const seconds = Math.floor(d.getSeconds() / 2);

  const time = (hours << 11) | (minutes << 5) | seconds;
  const date = ((year - 1980) << 9) | (month << 5) | day;
  return { time, date };
}

// Precomputed CRC32 table (IEEE 802.3) for backward-compatible packaging on Node < 20.15 / Node 18
const CRC_TABLE = new Uint32Array(256);
for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
  let c = i;
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
    c = (c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);
  }
  CRC_TABLE[i] = c >>> 0;
}

function calculateCRC32(buf) {
  if (typeof zlib.crc32 === 'function') {
    return (zlib.crc32(buf)) >>> 0;
  }
  let crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;
  for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
    crc = (crc >>> 8) ^ CRC_TABLE[(crc ^ buf[i]) & 0xFF];
  }
  return (crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) >>> 0;
}

function buildZip(files, outputPath) {
  const localChunks = [];
  const cdChunks = [];
  let offset = 0;
  const dt = dosDateTime();

  for (const f of files) {
    const nameBuf = Buffer.from(f.relPath, 'utf8');
    const content = fs.readFileSync(f.fullPath);
    const uncompressedSize = content.length;
    const crc = calculateCRC32(content);

    let method = 8; // Deflate
    let compressed = zlib.deflateRawSync(content, { level: 9 });
    let compressedSize = compressed.length;

    // If deflate doesn't reduce size (e.g. already compressed images), store uncompressed
    if (compressedSize >= uncompressedSize) {
      method = 0; // Stored
      compressed = content;
      compressedSize = uncompressedSize;
    }

    // Local file header (30 bytes + name)
    const lh = Buffer.alloc(30 + nameBuf.length);
    lh.writeUInt32LE(0x04034b50, 0);       // Signature
    lh.writeUInt16LE(20, 4);                // Version needed (2.0)
    lh.writeUInt16LE(0x0800, 6);            // Flags (bit 11 = UTF-8)
    lh.writeUInt16LE(method, 8);            // Compression method
    lh.writeUInt16LE(dt.time, 10);          // Mod time
    lh.writeUInt16LE(dt.date, 12);          // Mod date
    lh.writeUInt32LE(crc, 14);              // CRC32
    lh.writeUInt32LE(compressedSize, 18);   // Compressed size
    lh.writeUInt32LE(uncompressedSize, 22); // Uncompressed size
    lh.writeUInt16LE(nameBuf.length, 26);   // Filename length
    lh.writeUInt16LE(0, 28);                // Extra field length
    nameBuf.copy(lh, 30);

    // Central directory header (46 bytes + name)
    const cdh = Buffer.alloc(46 + nameBuf.length);
    cdh.writeUInt32LE(0x02014b50, 0);       // Signature
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(20, 4);               // Version made by (2.0)
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(20, 6);               // Version needed (2.0)
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(0x0800, 8);           // Flags (bit 11 = UTF-8)
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(method, 10);          // Compression method
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(dt.time, 12);         // Mod time
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(dt.date, 14);         // Mod date
    cdh.writeUInt32LE(crc, 16);             // CRC32
    cdh.writeUInt32LE(compressedSize, 20);  // Compressed size
    cdh.writeUInt32LE(uncompressedSize, 24);// Uncompressed size
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(nameBuf.length, 28);  // Filename length
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(0, 30);               // Extra field length
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(0, 32);               // Comment length
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(0, 34);               // Disk number start
    cdh.writeUInt16LE(0, 36);               // Internal file attributes
    cdh.writeUInt32LE((0o100644 * 65536) >>> 0, 38); // External file attributes
    cdh.writeUInt32LE(offset, 42);          // Relative offset of local header
    nameBuf.copy(cdh, 46);

    localChunks.push(lh, compressed);
    cdChunks.push(cdh);
    offset += lh.length + compressed.length;
  }

  const cdOffset = offset;
  let cdSize = 0;
  for (const cdh of cdChunks) {
    cdSize += cdh.length;
  }

  // End of Central Directory record (22 bytes)
  const eocd = Buffer.alloc(22);
  eocd.writeUInt32LE(0x06054b50, 0);        // Signature
  eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 4);                 // Disk number
  eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 6);                 // Start disk
  eocd.writeUInt16LE(files.length, 8);      // Total entries on this disk
  eocd.writeUInt16LE(files.length, 10);     // Total entries
  eocd.writeUInt32LE(cdSize, 12);           // Central directory size
  eocd.writeUInt32LE(cdOffset, 16);         // Central directory offset
  eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 20);                // Comment length

  const finalBuffer = Buffer.concat([...localChunks, ...cdChunks, eocd]);
  fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, finalBuffer);
  return finalBuffer.length;
}

function validateZip(zipPath) {
  const buf = fs.readFileSync(zipPath);
  let eocdOffset = -1;
  for (let i = buf.length - 22; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (buf.readUInt32LE(i) === 0x06054b50) {
      eocdOffset = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (eocdOffset === -1) {
    throw new Error('Packaging validation error: EOCD record not found!');
  }

  const totalEntries = buf.readUInt16LE(eocdOffset + 10);
  const cdOffset = buf.readUInt32LE(eocdOffset + 16);

  const entryNames = [];
  let curr = cdOffset;
  for (let i = 0; i < totalEntries; i++) {
    const sig = buf.readUInt32LE(curr);
    if (sig !== 0x02014b50) break;
    const nameLen = buf.readUInt16LE(curr + 28);
    const extraLen = buf.readUInt16LE(curr + 30);
    const commentLen = buf.readUInt16LE(curr + 32);
    const name = buf.toString('utf8', curr + 46, curr + 46 + nameLen);
    entryNames.push(name.replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    curr += 46 + nameLen + extraLen + commentLen;
  }

  // Check forbidden extensions
  for (const entry of entryNames) {
    const ext = path.extname(entry).toLowerCase();
    if (EXCLUDED_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
      throw new Error(`Packaging validation failed: forbidden file found in zip: ${entry}`);
    }
    if (entry.startsWith('native/bin/') || entry.startsWith('tests/') || entry.startsWith('docs/')) {
      throw new Error(`Packaging validation failed: forbidden directory in zip: ${entry}`);
    }
    if (entry === 'popup.html' || entry === 'popup.js') {
      throw new Error(`Packaging validation failed: orphan root popup file found in zip: ${entry}`);
    }
  }

  // Check required files
  const required = ['manifest.json', 'background.chrome.js', 'popup/popup.html', 'popup/popup.js'];
  for (const req of required) {
    if (!entryNames.includes(req)) {
      throw new Error(`Packaging validation failed: missing critical file ${req}`);
    }
  }

  return entryNames;
}

// Execute packaging
console.log(`Packaging VidManager Extension v${version} for Chrome Web Store...`);
const filesToPackage = collectFiles(ROOT_DIR);
console.log(`Collected ${filesToPackage.length} clean extension files.`);

// A previous zip may be held open by Explorer/7-Zip/antivirus (EBUSY on write).
// Clear it when possible; if it stays locked, fall back to a standby name so
// the build never dies mid-run.
let zipPath = ZIP_PATH;
try {
  if (fs.existsSync(zipPath)) fs.unlinkSync(zipPath);
} catch (e) {
  zipPath = path.join(DIST_DIR, ZIP_NAME.replace(/\.zip$/, '') + '-new.zip');
  console.warn(`WARNING: ${ZIP_NAME} is locked by another program (close the zip viewer).`);
  console.warn(`         Writing to ${path.basename(zipPath)} instead.`);
  try { if (fs.existsSync(zipPath)) fs.unlinkSync(zipPath); } catch (_) {}
}

const zipSizeBytes = buildZip(filesToPackage, zipPath);
const zipSizeMB = (zipSizeBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2);
console.log(`Successfully generated: ${path.relative(ROOT_DIR, zipPath)} (${zipSizeBytes} bytes / ${zipSizeMB} MB)`);

// Validate size
const MAX_ALLOWED_BYTES = 15 * 1024 * 1024; // 15MB
if (zipSizeBytes > MAX_ALLOWED_BYTES) {
  console.error(`ERROR: Package size ${zipSizeMB} MB exceeds 15MB limit!`);
  process.exit(1);
}

// Validate package cleanliness
const verifiedEntries = validateZip(zipPath);
console.log(`Validated ${verifiedEntries.length} entries inside release zip:`);
console.log(` - Executables: 0`);
console.log(` - Log files: 0`);
console.log(` - Package size: ${zipSizeMB} MB (limit: 15 MB)`);
console.log(`Package ready for Chrome Web Store distribution!`);
</file>

<file path="downloads/downloads.js">
/**
 * Universal Video Downloader - VidManager Downloads Manager
 * Handles real-time download tracking, filtering, searching, and Explorer actions.
 */

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const downloadsContainer = document.getElementById('downloads-container');
  const emptyState = document.getElementById('empty-state');
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');
  const btnClearSearch = document.getElementById('btn-clear-search');
  const btnOpenFolder = document.getElementById('btn-open-folder');
  const btnClearAll = document.getElementById('btn-clear-all');
  const btnChangeFolder = document.getElementById('btn-change-folder');
  const sidebarFolderPath = document.getElementById('sidebar-folder-path');
  const sectionTitle = document.getElementById('section-title');
  const sectionStats = document.getElementById('section-stats');
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');

  const countAll = document.getElementById('count-all');
  const countDownloading = document.getElementById('count-downloading');
  const countCompleted = document.getElementById('count-completed');
  const countVideo = document.getElementById('count-video');
  const countAudio = document.getElementById('count-audio');

  const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');

  let currentFilter = 'all';
  let searchQuery = '';
  let allItems = []; // merged list of download records
  const recentlyDeletedIds = new Set();

  function safeSendMessage(msg, callback) {
    try {
      if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.runtime && chrome.runtime.sendMessage) {
        chrome.runtime.sendMessage(msg, (res) => {
          if (chrome.runtime.lastError) {
            if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(null);
            return;
          }
          if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(res);
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (typeof callback === 'function') callback(null);
    }
  }

  function showToast(msg) {
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = msg;
    toast.style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(() => {
      toast.style.display = 'none';
    }, 2500);
  }

  function formatBytes(bytes) {
    if (!bytes || isNaN(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0 B';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    let size = bytes;
    let unitIndex = 0;
    while (size >= 1024 && unitIndex < units.length - 1) {
      size /= 1024;
      unitIndex++;
    }
    return `${size.toFixed(1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;
  }

  function formatDate(timestamp) {
    if (!timestamp) return 'Gần đây';
    const d = new Date(timestamp);
    const today = new Date();
    if (d.toDateString() === today.toDateString()) {
      return `Hôm nay lúc ${d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}`;
    }
    const yesterday = new Date(today);
    yesterday.setDate(today.getDate() - 1);
    if (d.toDateString() === yesterday.toDateString()) {
      return `Hôm qua lúc ${d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}`;
    }
    return d.toLocaleDateString([], { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
  }

  // Format raw error into clean, understandable Vietnamese reason
  function formatErrorMessage(raw) {
    if (!raw) return 'Lỗi không xác định';
    const str = String(raw).trim();

    if (str.includes('Sign in to confirm') || str.includes('bot') || str.includes('n-challenge')) {
      return 'YouTube yêu cầu xác minh bot hoặc tài khoản';
    }
    if (str.includes('Private video') || str.includes('This video is private')) {
      return 'Video ở chế độ riêng tư (Private)';
    }
    if (str.includes('Members-only')) {
      return 'Video chỉ dành cho Hội viên có trả phí';
    }
    if (str.includes('Video unavailable') || str.includes('This video is not available')) {
      return 'Video không khả dụng hoặc đã bị gỡ';
    }
    if (str.includes('403') || str.includes('Forbidden') || str.includes('SERVER_FORBIDDEN')) {
      return 'Máy chủ từ chối kết nối (HTTP 403). Liên kết tải có thể đã hết hạn.';
    }
    if (str.includes('NETWORK_FAILED') || str.includes('ECONNREFUSED') || str.includes('ENOTFOUND')) {
      return 'Lỗi kết nối mạng Internet';
    }
    if (str.includes('FILE_ACCESS_DENIED') || str.includes('EACCES')) {
      return 'Không có quyền lưu file vào thư mục đích';
    }
    if (str.includes('disk full') || str.includes('ENOSPC')) {
      return 'Ổ đĩa đầy, không đủ dung lượng lưu trữ';
    }
    if (str.includes('Host disconnected') || str.includes('Specified native messaging host not found')) {
      return 'Native Helper chưa chạy hoặc bị ngắt kết nối';
    }
    if (str.includes('FFmpeg exited')) {
      return 'Lỗi xử lý ghép file bằng FFmpeg';
    }
    if (str.includes('Unsupported URL') || str.includes('trang chủ') || str.includes('Chưa bắt được')) {
      return 'Chưa bắt được luồng video (Bấm phát video rồi ấn tải lại)';
    }

    const cleaned = str.replace(/^ERROR:\s*(\[[^\]]+\]\s*)?/i, '').split('\n')[0].trim();
    return cleaned.length > 80 ? cleaned.slice(0, 80) + '...' : cleaned;
  }

  // Load downloads from local storage and chrome.downloads
  async function loadDownloads() {
    let map = new Map();
    try {
      const storageData = await chrome.storage.local.get(['downloadHistory', 'customDownloadDir']);
      const nativeHistory = Array.isArray(storageData.downloadHistory) ? storageData.downloadHistory : [];
      if (storageData.customDownloadDir) {
        if (sidebarFolderPath) {
          sidebarFolderPath.textContent = storageData.customDownloadDir;
          sidebarFolderPath.title = storageData.customDownloadDir;
        }
        if (modalFolderPath) {
          modalFolderPath.textContent = storageData.customDownloadDir;
          modalFolderPath.title = storageData.customDownloadDir;
        }
      }

      // Query browser downloads
      let chromeDownloads = [];
      try {
        chromeDownloads = await chrome.downloads.search({ orderBy: ['-startTime'], limit: 50 });
      } catch (e) {}

      // Only show browser downloads that this extension itself created. Without
      // this filter, the manager leaks in unrelated Chrome download history.
      const managedChromeIds = new Set(nativeHistory
        .filter(item => item && (item.chromeId || item.isBrowserDownload))
        .map(item => String(item.chromeId || item.id)));
      const normalizedChrome = chromeDownloads
        .filter(cd => {
          const myExtId = (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.runtime && chrome.runtime.id) ? chrome.runtime.id : '';
          const strId = String(cd.id);
          if (recentlyDeletedIds.has(strId)) return false;
          if (managedChromeIds.has(strId)) return true;
          if (myExtId && cd.byExtensionId === myExtId) return true;
          return false;
        })
        .map(cd => {
          const fn = cd.filename || '';
          const isAudio = /\.(mp3|m4a|aac|flac|wav)$/i.test(fn);
          const isVideo = /\.(mp4|webm|mkv|mov|ts|flv|m4s|avi)$/i.test(fn);
          let state = 'downloading';
          let errorMessage = '';
          if (cd.state === 'complete') {
            state = 'completed';
          } else if (cd.state === 'interrupted') {
            if (cd.error === 'USER_CANCELED') {
              state = 'canceled';
            } else {
              state = 'error';
            }
            errorMessage = formatErrorMessage(cd.error || 'Gián đoạn');
          }

          const totalBytes = cd.totalBytes > 0 ? cd.totalBytes : cd.fileSize || 0;
          const receivedBytes = cd.bytesReceived || 0;
          const pct = totalBytes > 0 ? Math.round((receivedBytes / totalBytes) * 100) : 0;

          return {
            id: cd.id,
            chromeId: cd.id,
            title: (cd.filename ? cd.filename.split(/[\\/]/).pop() : 'download'),
            filename: cd.filename || '',
            url: cd.url || '',
            startTime: new Date(cd.startTime).getTime(),
            state: state,
            totalBytes: totalBytes,
            receivedBytes: receivedBytes,
            percent: `${pct}%`,
            speed: '',
            error: cd.error || '',
            errorMessage: errorMessage,
            format: isAudio ? 'MP3' : (isVideo ? 'MP4' : 'FILE'),
            type: isAudio ? 'audio' : (isVideo ? 'video' : 'other')
          };
        });

      // Check active engine status
      let activeItem = null;
      let activeIds = new Set();
      try {
        const statusRes = await new Promise((resolve) => {
          chrome.runtime.sendMessage({ action: 'getDownloadStatus' }, (res) => {
            if (chrome.runtime.lastError) {
              resolve(null);
            } else {
              resolve(res);
            }
          });
        });
        if (statusRes) {
          if (statusRes.item) activeItem = statusRes.item;
          if (Array.isArray(statusRes.activeTaskIds)) {
            activeIds = new Set(statusRes.activeTaskIds);
          } else if (Array.isArray(statusRes.activeDownloads)) {
            activeIds = new Set(statusRes.activeDownloads.map(t => t.id));
          } else if (activeItem && activeItem.id) {
            activeIds.add(activeItem.id);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      // Combine and deduplicate
      map.clear();
      const now = Date.now();
      for (const item of nativeHistory) {
        if (!item) continue;
        item.fromHistory = true;
        const strId = String(item.id || '');
        const strChromeId = item.chromeId ? String(item.chromeId) : '';
        if (recentlyDeletedIds.has(strId) || (strChromeId && recentlyDeletedIds.has(strChromeId))) {
          continue;
        }

        // Normalize state strings from background
        if (item.state === 'in_progress') item.state = 'downloading';
        if (item.state === 'complete') item.state = 'completed';
        if (item.state === 'interrupted' && item.error !== 'USER_CANCELED') item.state = 'error';

        const isFinished = item.percent === '100%' || item.speed === 'Hoàn thành';
        if (isFinished) {
          item.state = 'completed';
        }
        if (item.state === 'downloading') {
          const isTaskActive = activeIds.has(item.id) || (activeItem && activeItem.id === item.id);
          // If task is not active in the background engine
          if (!isTaskActive) {
            if (item.outputFile || item.outputPath || item.percent === '100%') {
              item.state = 'completed';
              item.percent = '100%';
            } else if (now - (item.startTime || 0) > 300000) {
              item.state = 'error';
              item.error = 'Bị gián đoạn';
              item.errorMessage = 'Bị gián đoạn';
            }
          }
        }

        if (!item.errorMessage && item.error) {
          item.errorMessage = formatErrorMessage(item.error);
        }
        map.set(item.id || item.filename || item.url, item);
      }

      for (const item of normalizedChrome) {
        const strId = String(item.id || '');
        const strChromeId = item.chromeId ? String(item.chromeId) : '';
        if (recentlyDeletedIds.has(strId) || (strChromeId && recentlyDeletedIds.has(strChromeId))) {
          continue;
        }

        // Deduplicate against existing items in map by chromeId, id, url, or filename
        let existingMatch = null;
        for (const existing of map.values()) {
          if (item.chromeId && (String(existing.chromeId || '') === String(item.chromeId) || String(existing.id || '') === String(item.chromeId))) {
            existingMatch = existing;
            break;
          }
          if (item.id && String(existing.id || '') === String(item.id)) {
            existingMatch = existing;
            break;
          }
          if (item.url && existing.url && item.url === existing.url) {
            existingMatch = existing;
            break;
          }
          if (item.filename && existing.filename && item.filename === existing.filename) {
            existingMatch = existing;
            break;
          }
        }

        if (existingMatch) {
          existingMatch.fromHistory = true;
          if (!existingMatch.chromeId && item.chromeId) existingMatch.chromeId = item.chromeId;
          if (!existingMatch.filename && item.filename) existingMatch.filename = item.filename;
          if ((!existingMatch.title || existingMatch.title === 'download') && item.title && item.title !== 'download') {
            existingMatch.title = item.title;
          }
          if (existingMatch.state === 'downloading' && item.state !== 'downloading') {
            existingMatch.state = item.state;
          }
        } else {
          item.isChromeOnly = true;
          map.set(item.id, item);
        }
      }

      allItems = Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => (b.startTime || 0) - (a.startTime || 0));
      updateCounts();
      renderList();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[DownloadsManager] loadDownloads error:', err);
      if (allItems.length === 0 && typeof map !== 'undefined' && map && map.size > 0) {
        allItems = Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => (b.startTime || 0) - (a.startTime || 0));
      }
      renderList();
    }
  }

  function formatDisplayUrl(item) {
    if (item.referer && !item.referer.includes('googlevideo.com') && !item.referer.includes('fbcdn.net')) {
      return item.referer;
    }
    if (!item.url) return '';
    try {
      const u = new URL(item.url);
      if (u.hostname.includes('googlevideo.com')) {
        return item.referer || 'https://www.youtube.com/';
      }
      if (u.hostname.includes('fbcdn.net')) {
        return item.referer || 'https://www.facebook.com/';
      }
      if (u.hostname.includes('byteoversea.com') || u.hostname.includes('ibytedtos.com')) {
        return item.referer || 'https://www.tiktok.com/';
      }
      return u.origin + u.pathname;
    } catch (e) {
      return item.url.split('?')[0];
    }
  }

  function formatPercentWidth(pct) {
    if (!pct) return '0%';
    const m = String(pct).match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%/);
    if (m) {
      const val = parseFloat(m[1]);
      return `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, val))}%`;
    }
    const val = parseFloat(pct);
    if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 0 && val <= 100) return `${val}%`;
    return '0%';
  }

  function isAudioItem(it) {
    if (!it) return false;
    const fn = (it.filename || it.outputPath || it.outputFile || it.title || '').toLowerCase();
    return it.type === 'audio' || /\.(mp3|m4a|aac|flac|wav|ogg)$/i.test(fn);
  }

  function isVideoItem(it) {
    if (!it) return false;
    if (it.type === 'image' || isAudioItem(it)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  function updateCounts() {
    const total = allItems.length;
    const downloading = allItems.filter(it => it.state === 'downloading').length;
    const completed = allItems.filter(it => it.state === 'completed').length;
    const video = allItems.filter(it => isVideoItem(it)).length;
    const audio = allItems.filter(it => isAudioItem(it)).length;

    if (countAll) countAll.textContent = total;
    if (countDownloading) countDownloading.textContent = downloading;
    if (countCompleted) countCompleted.textContent = completed;
    if (countVideo) countVideo.textContent = video;
    if (countAudio) countAudio.textContent = audio;
  }

  function getFilteredItems() {
    return allItems.filter(item => {
      // Filter by category
      if (currentFilter === 'downloading' && item.state !== 'downloading') return false;
      if (currentFilter === 'completed' && item.state !== 'completed') return false;
      if (currentFilter === 'video' && !isVideoItem(item)) return false;
      if (currentFilter === 'audio' && !isAudioItem(item)) return false;

      // Filter by search query
      if (searchQuery) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const titleMatch = (item.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const urlMatch = (item.url || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!titleMatch && !urlMatch) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  }

  function getDateGroupHeading(timestamp) {
    if (!timestamp || isNaN(new Date(timestamp).getTime())) return 'Gần đây';
    const d = new Date(timestamp);
    const now = new Date();

    const dDate = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
    const nowDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    const diffDays = Math.round((nowDate - dDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

    const day = d.getDate();
    const month = d.getMonth() + 1;
    const year = d.getFullYear();

    if (diffDays === 0) {
      return `Hôm nay, ${day} tháng ${month}, ${year}`;
    } else if (diffDays === 1) {
      return `Hôm qua, ${day} tháng ${month}, ${year}`;
    } else {
      return `${day} tháng ${month}, ${year}`;
    }
  }

  function createSvgEl(tag, attrs = {}) {
    const el = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', tag);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) {
      el.setAttribute(k, String(v));
    }
    return el;
  }

  function createAlertSvg(w = 14, h = 14, stroke = '#dc2626') {
    const svg = createSvgEl('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 24 24', width: w, height: h, fill: 'none', stroke, 'stroke-width': '2', 'stroke-linecap': 'round', 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' });
    const circle = createSvgEl('circle', { cx: '12', cy: '12', r: '10' });
    const l1 = createSvgEl('line', { x1: '12', y1: '8', x2: '12', y2: '12' });
    const l2 = createSvgEl('line', { x1: '12', y1: '16', x2: '12.01', y2: '16' });
    svg.append(circle, l1, l2);
    return svg;
  }

  function createInfoSvg(w = 14, h = 14, stroke = '#64748b') {
    const svg = createSvgEl('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 24 24', width: w, height: h, fill: 'none', stroke, 'stroke-width': '2', 'stroke-linecap': 'round', 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' });
    const circle = createSvgEl('circle', { cx: '12', cy: '12', r: '10' });
    const l1 = createSvgEl('line', { x1: '12', y1: '16', x2: '12', y2: '12' });
    const l2 = createSvgEl('line', { x1: '12', y1: '8', x2: '12.01', y2: '8' });
    svg.append(circle, l1, l2);
    return svg;
  }

  function createMoreDotsSvg(w = 16, h = 16, fill = '#64748b') {
    const svg = createSvgEl('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 24 24', width: w, height: h, fill });
    const c1 = createSvgEl('circle', { cx: '12', cy: '5', r: '1.75' });
    const c2 = createSvgEl('circle', { cx: '12', cy: '12', r: '1.75' });
    const c3 = createSvgEl('circle', { cx: '12', cy: '19', r: '1.75' });
    svg.append(c1, c2, c3);
    return svg;
  }

  function createRemoveSvg(w = 12, h = 12, stroke = '#64748b') {
    const svg = createSvgEl('svg', { viewBox: '0 0 24 24', width: w, height: h, fill: 'none', stroke, 'stroke-width': '2.2', 'stroke-linecap': 'round' });
    const l1 = createSvgEl('line', { x1: '18', y1: '6', x2: '6', y2: '18' });
    const l2 = createSvgEl('line', { x1: '6', y1: '6', x2: '18', y2: '18' });
    svg.append(l1, l2);
    return svg;
  }

  function createCardIcon(item) {
    const fn = (item.filename || item.title || '').toLowerCase();
    const isAudio = item.type === 'audio' || /\.(mp3|m4a|aac|flac|wav)$/i.test(fn);
    const isExe = /\.(exe|msi|bat|cmd)$/i.test(fn);

    const iconWrap = document.createElement('div');
    iconWrap.className = 'card-icon-wrap';

    if (isAudio) {
      iconWrap.innerHTML = `
        <svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" width="40" height="40" fill="none">
          <rect width="44" height="44" rx="8" fill="#f5f3ff"/>
          <path d="M18 29a3 3 0 1 1-6 0 3 3 0 0 1 6 0zm14-4a3 3 0 1 1-6 0 3 3 0 0 1 6 0z" fill="#7c3aed"/>
