          <path d="M18 29V14l14-4v15" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        </svg>
      `;
    } else if (isExe) {
      iconWrap.innerHTML = `
        <svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" width="40" height="40" fill="none">
          <rect width="44" height="44" rx="8" fill="#f1f5f9"/>
          <rect x="12" y="12" width="20" height="20" rx="3" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
          <line x1="12" y1="18" x2="32" y2="18" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2"/>
        </svg>
      `;
    } else {
      iconWrap.innerHTML = `
        <svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" width="40" height="40" fill="none">
          <rect width="44" height="44" rx="8" fill="#ecfdf5"/>
          <path d="M14 15h12a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v10a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H14a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V17a2 2 0 0 1 2-2z" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
          <path d="M28 20l5-3v10l-5-3v-4z" fill="#059669"/>
        </svg>
      `;
    }

    return iconWrap;
  }

  function showCardContextMenu(triggerBtn, item) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.card-menu-dropdown').forEach(d => d.remove());

    const menu = document.createElement('div');
    menu.className = 'card-menu-dropdown';

    const itemCopy = document.createElement('div');
    itemCopy.className = 'menu-dropdown-item';
    itemCopy.textContent = 'Sao chép liên kết tải xuống';
    itemCopy.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      menu.remove();
      if (item.url) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(item.url).then(() => showToast('Đã sao chép liên kết!')).catch(() => {});
      }
    });

    const itemDel = document.createElement('div');
    itemDel.className = 'menu-dropdown-item danger';
    itemDel.textContent = item.state === 'downloading' ? 'Hủy tải xuống' : 'Xoá khỏi danh sách';
    itemDel.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      menu.remove();
      if (item.state === 'downloading') {
        if (confirm('Bạn có muốn hủy tải xuống video này không?')) {
          cancelDownloadItem(item);
        }
      } else {
        deleteItem(item.id);
      }
    });

    menu.append(itemCopy, itemDel);
    triggerBtn.parentElement.appendChild(menu);

    const closeMenu = (e) => {
      if (!menu.contains(e.target)) {
        menu.remove();
        document.removeEventListener('click', closeMenu);
      }
    };
    setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener('click', closeMenu), 0);
  }

  function openDownloadedItem(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    if (item.state === 'downloading') {
      showToast(`Tệp đang được tải (${item.percent || '0%'}), vui lòng chờ...`);
      return;
    }
    if (item.state === 'canceled') {
      showToast('Tệp đã bị hủy. Bấm Thử lại để tải lại.');
      return;
    }
    if (item.state === 'deleted') {
      showToast('Tệp không còn trên đĩa. Bấm Thử lại để tải lại.');
      return;
    }

    const title = item.title || 'video.mp4';
    showToast(`Đang mở: ${title}...`);

    chrome.runtime.sendMessage({
      action: 'openFile',
      id: item.id,
      chromeId: item.chromeId,
      path: item.outputPath || item.outputFile || item.filename || '',
      filename: item.filename || item.outputFile || item.outputPath || item.title || '',
      title: item.title || ''
    }, (res) => {
      if (chrome.runtime?.lastError) return;
      if (res && res.success) {
        showToast(`Đang mở: ${title}`);
      } else if (res && (res.fileNotFound || (res.error && res.error.includes('Không tìm thấy')))) {
        item.state = 'deleted';
        renderList();
        showToast('Tệp không còn trên đĩa. Bấm Thử lại để tải lại.');
      } else if (res && res.error) {
        showToast(res.error);
      }
    });
  }

  function createDownloadCard(item) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'download-card';
    card.id = `card_${item.id}`;

    const isDownloading = item.state === 'downloading' || item.state === 'in_progress';
    const isError = item.state === 'error' || (item.state === 'interrupted' && item.error !== 'USER_CANCELED');
    const isDeleted = item.state === 'deleted' || item.fileMissing;
    const isCanceled = item.state === 'canceled' || item.state === 'cancelled' || item.error === 'USER_CANCELED';
    const isCompleted = (item.state === 'completed' || item.state === 'complete') && !isDeleted && !isCanceled && !isError;
    const fn = (item.filename || item.title || '').toLowerCase();
    const isAudio = item.type === 'audio' || /\.(mp3|m4a|aac|flac|wav)$/i.test(fn);
    const isVideo = !isAudio && !/\.(exe|msi|zip|rar|7z|tar|gz)$/i.test(fn);

    if (isDeleted) {
      card.classList.add('card-missing-file');
    }

    // 1. Icon Box
    const iconBox = createCardIcon(item);
    card.appendChild(iconBox);

    // 2. Middle Details Area
    const details = document.createElement('div');
    details.className = 'card-details';

    // Row 1: Title and Status
    const topRow = document.createElement('div');
    topRow.className = 'card-top-row';

    if (isCompleted) {
      const titleLink = document.createElement('a');
      titleLink.className = 'item-title-link';
      titleLink.href = '#';
      titleLink.textContent = item.title || 'video.mp4';
      titleLink.title = item.title || '';
      titleLink.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        e.preventDefault();
        openDownloadedItem(item);
      });
      topRow.appendChild(titleLink);
    } else if (isError) {
      const titleMuted = document.createElement('span');
      titleMuted.className = 'item-title-muted';
      titleMuted.textContent = item.title || 'video.mp4';
      titleMuted.title = item.title || '';

      const statusTag = document.createElement('span');
      statusTag.className = 'item-status-tag error';
      statusTag.textContent = 'Lỗi tải';

      topRow.append(titleMuted, statusTag);
    } else if (isDeleted) {
      const titleMuted = document.createElement('span');
      titleMuted.className = 'item-title-muted';
      titleMuted.textContent = item.title || 'video.mp4';
      titleMuted.title = (item.title || '') + ' (Tệp không còn trên đĩa)';

      const statusTag = document.createElement('span');
      statusTag.className = 'item-status-tag error';
      statusTag.textContent = 'Đã xóa';

      topRow.append(titleMuted, statusTag);
    } else if (isCanceled) {
      const titleMuted = document.createElement('span');
      titleMuted.className = 'item-title-muted';
      titleMuted.textContent = item.title || 'video.mp4';
      titleMuted.title = item.title || '';

      const statusTag = document.createElement('span');
      statusTag.className = 'item-status-tag';
      statusTag.textContent = 'Đã hủy';

      topRow.append(titleMuted, statusTag);
    } else if (isDownloading) {
      const titleTxt = document.createElement('span');
      titleTxt.className = 'item-title-downloading';
      titleTxt.textContent = item.title || 'video.mp4';

      const progInfo = document.createElement('span');
      progInfo.className = 'item-downloading-stats';
      const spd = item.speed ? ` • ${item.speed}` : '';
      const displayPct = (item.percent && item.percent.includes('%')) ? item.percent : (item.speed ? 'Đang tải...' : '0%');
      progInfo.textContent = `${displayPct}${spd}`;

      topRow.append(titleTxt, progInfo);
    }

    // Row 2: Source URL
    const urlRow = document.createElement('div');
    urlRow.className = 'card-url-row';
    urlRow.textContent = formatDisplayUrl(item);
    urlRow.title = item.url || '';
    urlRow.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const sourceUrl = item.pageUrl || item.referer || item.url;
      if (sourceUrl && sourceUrl.startsWith('http')) {
        window.open(sourceUrl, '_blank');
      }
    });

    // Row 3: Actions row
    const actionsRow = document.createElement('div');
    actionsRow.className = 'card-actions-row';

    if (isCompleted) {
      const btnFolder = document.createElement('button');
      btnFolder.type = 'button';
      btnFolder.className = 'action-link-btn btn-show-folder';
      btnFolder.textContent = 'Mở trong thư mục';
      btnFolder.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        safeSendMessage({
          action: 'showInFolder',
          chromeId: item.chromeId,
          path: item.outputPath || item.outputFile || item.filename || ''
        });
      });
      actionsRow.appendChild(btnFolder);

      if (isVideo || isAudio) {
        const btnPlay = document.createElement('button');
        btnPlay.type = 'button';
        btnPlay.className = 'action-link-btn btn-play-media';
        btnPlay.textContent = 'Phát';
        btnPlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          openDownloadedItem(item);
        });
        actionsRow.appendChild(btnPlay);
      }
    } else if (isError) {
      const progTrack = document.createElement('div');
      progTrack.className = 'item-progress-track';
      const progFill = document.createElement('div');
      progFill.className = 'item-progress-fill error';
      progFill.style.width = formatPercentWidth(item.percent || '0%');
      progTrack.appendChild(progFill);

      const btnRetry = document.createElement('button');
      btnRetry.type = 'button';
      btnRetry.className = 'btn-retry-download';
      const mustRefresh = needsFreshMediaUrl(item);
      btnRetry.textContent = mustRefresh ? 'Lấy lại luồng' : 'Thử lại';
      btnRetry.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (mustRefresh) refreshMediaUrl(item); else retryDownload(item);
      });

      actionsRow.append(progTrack, btnRetry);
    } else if (isDeleted || isCanceled) {
      const btnRetry = document.createElement('button');
      btnRetry.type = 'button';
      btnRetry.className = 'btn-retry-download';
      const mustRefresh = needsFreshMediaUrl(item);
      btnRetry.textContent = mustRefresh ? 'Lấy lại luồng' : 'Thử lại';
      btnRetry.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (mustRefresh) refreshMediaUrl(item); else retryDownload(item);
      });
      actionsRow.appendChild(btnRetry);
    } else if (isDownloading) {
      const progTrack = document.createElement('div');
      progTrack.className = 'item-progress-track';
      const progFill = document.createElement('div');
      progFill.className = 'item-progress-fill';
      progFill.style.width = formatPercentWidth(item.percent);
      progTrack.appendChild(progFill);

      actionsRow.appendChild(progTrack);
    }

    if (isCanceled || isError) {
      const errRow = document.createElement('div');
      errRow.className = 'item-error-row';
      const errIcon = document.createElement('span');
      errIcon.className = 'error-badge-icon';
      errIcon.appendChild(isCanceled ? createInfoSvg(13, 13, '#64748b') : createAlertSvg(13, 13, '#dc2626'));
      const errTitle = document.createElement('span');
      errTitle.className = 'error-badge-title';
      errTitle.textContent = isCanceled ? 'Trạng thái:' : 'Nguyên nhân:';

      const shortErr = isCanceled ? 'Người dùng đã hủy' : (item.errorMessage || formatErrorMessage(item.error));
      const fullErr = String(item.error || item.errorMessage || shortErr);

      const errDesc = document.createElement('span');
      errDesc.className = 'error-badge-text';
      errDesc.textContent = shortErr;
      errDesc.title = shortErr;

      errRow.append(errIcon, errTitle, errDesc);

      // Expandable full technical error details
      if (!isCanceled && (fullErr.length > 40 || fullErr !== shortErr)) {
        const btnToggleErr = document.createElement('button');
        btnToggleErr.type = 'button';
        btnToggleErr.className = 'btn-toggle-error-detail';
        btnToggleErr.textContent = 'Chi tiết';
        btnToggleErr.title = 'Xem thông tin lỗi kỹ thuật đầy đủ';

        let isExpanded = false;
        const toggleDetail = (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          isExpanded = !isExpanded;
          if (isExpanded) {
            errRow.classList.add('expanded');
            errDesc.textContent = fullErr;
            btnToggleErr.textContent = 'Thu gọn';
          } else {
            errRow.classList.remove('expanded');
            errDesc.textContent = shortErr;
            btnToggleErr.textContent = 'Chi tiết';
          }
        };

        btnToggleErr.addEventListener('click', toggleDetail);
        errDesc.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        errDesc.addEventListener('click', toggleDetail);
        errRow.append(btnToggleErr);
      }

      details.append(topRow, urlRow, errRow, actionsRow);
    } else {
      details.append(topRow, urlRow, actionsRow);
    }
    card.appendChild(details);

    // 3. Right Tools (⋮ and ✕)
    const tools = document.createElement('div');
    tools.className = 'card-tools';

    const btnMore = document.createElement('button');
    btnMore.type = 'button';
    btnMore.className = 'btn-card-more';
    btnMore.title = 'Tùy chọn khác';
    btnMore.appendChild(createMoreDotsSvg(14, 14, 'currentColor'));
    btnMore.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      showCardContextMenu(btnMore, item);
    });

    const btnRemove = document.createElement('button');
    btnRemove.type = 'button';
    btnRemove.className = 'btn-card-remove';
    btnRemove.title = isDownloading ? 'Hủy tải xuống' : 'Xóa khỏi danh sách';
    btnRemove.appendChild(createRemoveSvg(12, 12, 'currentColor'));
    btnRemove.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (isDownloading) {
        if (confirm('Bạn có muốn hủy tải xuống video này không?')) {
          cancelDownloadItem(item);
        }
      } else {
        deleteItem(item.id);
      }
    });

    tools.append(btnMore, btnRemove);
    card.appendChild(tools);

    return card;
  }

  function renderList() {
    const filtered = getFilteredItems();
    if (sectionStats) sectionStats.textContent = `${filtered.length} tệp`;

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      downloadsContainer.replaceChildren();
      emptyState.style.display = 'block';
      return;
    }

    emptyState.style.display = 'none';

    // Group items by Date Heading
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const item of filtered) {
      const heading = getDateGroupHeading(item.startTime);
      if (!groups.has(heading)) {
        groups.set(heading, []);
      }
      groups.get(heading).push(item);
    }

    downloadsContainer.replaceChildren();

    for (const [headingText, itemsInGroup] of groups.entries()) {
      const groupSection = document.createElement('div');
      groupSection.className = 'date-group';

      const groupHeader = document.createElement('div');
      groupHeader.className = 'date-group-heading';
      groupHeader.textContent = headingText;
      groupSection.appendChild(groupHeader);

      for (const item of itemsInGroup) {
        const card = createDownloadCard(item);
        groupSection.appendChild(card);
      }

      downloadsContainer.appendChild(groupSection);
    }
  }

  function updateCardProgressInDOM(item) {
    const card = document.getElementById(`card_${item.id}`);
    if (!card) {
      renderList();
      return true;
    }

    if (item.state === 'downloading') {
      const progFill = card.querySelector('.item-progress-fill');
      if (progFill) {
        progFill.style.width = formatPercentWidth(item.percent);
      }
      const stats = card.querySelector('.item-downloading-stats');
      if (stats) {
        const spd = item.speed ? ` • ${item.speed}` : '';
        const displayPct = (item.percent && item.percent.includes('%')) ? item.percent : (item.speed ? 'Đang tải...' : '0%');
        stats.textContent = `${displayPct}${spd}`;
      }
      return true;
    }

    renderList();
    return true;
  }

  async function retryDownload(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    // Preserve the existing history ID so retry progress updates the same card.
    const retryTaskId = item.id;
    item.state = 'downloading';
    item.speed = 'Đang kết nối lại...';
    delete item.error;
    delete item.errorMessage;

    const storageData = await chrome.storage.local.get(['downloadHistory']);
    const list = Array.isArray(storageData.downloadHistory) ? storageData.downloadHistory : [];
    const found = list.find(it => it.id === item.id);
    if (found) {
      found.state = 'downloading';
      found.speed = 'Đang kết nối lại...';
      delete found.error;
      delete found.errorMessage;
      await chrome.storage.local.set({ downloadHistory: list });
    }

    renderList();
    showToast('Đang kết nối tải lại video...');

    safeSendMessage({
      action: 'downloadNative',
      taskId: retryTaskId,
      url: item.url,
      videoUrl: item.videoUrl || item.url,
      audioUrl: item.audioUrl || '',
      isYouTubeDash: Boolean(item.isYouTubeDash),
      title: item.title,
      quality: item.quality || (item.type === 'audio' ? 'audio' : 'best'),
      soundOnly: Boolean(item.soundOnly || item.type === 'audio'),
      referer: item.referer || item.pageUrl || item.url,
      pageUrl: item.pageUrl || item.url,
      outputDir: item.outputDir || '',
      duration: item.duration || 0,
      size: item.totalBytes || item.size || 0
    });
  }

  function needsFreshMediaUrl(item) {
    if (!item || !item.error) return false;
    const error = String(item.error);
    const url = String(item.videoUrl || item.url || '');
    const isForbidden = /403|forbidden|server_forbidden/i.test(error);
    const isExpiringCdn = /tiktok|byteoversea|ibytedtos|googlevideo|fbcdn|cdninstagram/i.test(url);
    return isForbidden && isExpiringCdn;
  }

  function refreshMediaUrl(item) {
    const sourceUrl = item.pageUrl || item.referer;
    if (!sourceUrl || !/^https?:\/\//i.test(sourceUrl)) {
      showToast('Không còn trang nguồn để lấy lại luồng. Hãy mở lại video và tải lại từ đó.');
      return;
    }
    safeSendMessage({ action: 'openSourcePage', url: sourceUrl }, (res) => {
      if (res && res.success) {
        showToast('Đã mở video nguồn. Hãy phát video vài giây rồi bấm tải lại.');
      } else {
        showToast((res && res.error) || 'Không thể mở trang nguồn.');
      }
    });
  }

  function cancelDownloadItem(item) {
    if (!item) return;
    if (item.chromeId && typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.downloads) {
      try {
        const numId = Number(item.chromeId);
        chrome.downloads.cancel(!isNaN(numId) ? numId : item.chromeId, () => {});
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    safeSendMessage({
      action: 'cancelDownload',
      taskId: item.id,
      chromeId: item.chromeId
    });
    item.state = 'canceled';
    item.error = 'Người dùng đã hủy';
    item.errorMessage = 'Người dùng đã hủy';
    item.speed = 'Đã hủy';

    if (typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.storage && chrome.storage.local) {
      chrome.storage.local.get(['downloadHistory']).then(res => {
        const history = Array.isArray(res && res.downloadHistory) ? res.downloadHistory : [];
        const entry = history.find(h => String(h.id) === String(item.id) || (h.chromeId && String(h.chromeId) === String(item.chromeId)));
        if (entry) {
          entry.state = 'canceled';
          entry.error = 'Người dùng đã hủy';
          entry.errorMessage = 'Người dùng đã hủy';
          entry.speed = 'Đã hủy';
          chrome.storage.local.set({ downloadHistory: history });
        }
      }).catch(() => {});
    }

    renderList();
    showToast('Đã hủy tải xuống');
  }

  async function deleteItem(id) {
    const target = allItems.find(it => String(it.id) === String(id) || String(it.chromeId) === String(id));
    const targetId = target ? target.id : id;
    const strTargetId = String(targetId);
    const chromeId = target ? target.chromeId : (String(id).startsWith('chrome_') ? id.replace('chrome_', '') : (Number.isInteger(Number(id)) ? Number(id) : null));
    const strChromeId = chromeId ? String(chromeId) : '';

    if (strTargetId) recentlyDeletedIds.add(strTargetId);
    if (strChromeId) recentlyDeletedIds.add(strChromeId);

    // 1. Immediately remove from memory and update UI
    allItems = allItems.filter(it => {
      const itId = String(it.id || '');
      const itChromeId = it.chromeId ? String(it.chromeId) : '';
      if (strTargetId && (itId === strTargetId || itChromeId === strTargetId)) return false;
      if (strChromeId && (itId === strChromeId || itChromeId === strChromeId)) return false;
      return true;
    });
    updateCounts();
    renderList();

    // 2. Erase from browser download shelf if applicable
    const numChromeId = Number(chromeId);
    if (!isNaN(numChromeId) && numChromeId > 0 && typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.downloads) {
      try {
        chrome.downloads.cancel(numChromeId, () => {
          try { chrome.downloads.erase({ id: chromeId }, () => {}); } catch (_) {}
        });
      } catch (_) {
        try { chrome.downloads.erase({ id: chromeId }, () => {}); } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    // 3. Notify background to cancel (if active) and purge permanently
    safeSendMessage({
      action: 'removeDownload',
      id: strTargetId,
      chromeId: strChromeId
    });

    // 4. Directly update local storage
    try {
      const storageData = await chrome.storage.local.get(['downloadHistory']);
      const currentHist = Array.isArray(storageData.downloadHistory) ? storageData.downloadHistory : [];
      const sanitized = currentHist.filter(it => {
        const itId = String(it.id || '');
        const itChromeId = it.chromeId ? String(it.chromeId) : '';
        if (strTargetId && (itId === strTargetId || itChromeId === strTargetId)) return false;
        if (strChromeId && (itId === strChromeId || itChromeId === strChromeId)) return false;
        return true;
      });
      await chrome.storage.local.set({ downloadHistory: sanitized });
    } catch (_) {}

    showToast('Đã xoá mục tải xuống!');
  }

  // Filter switching
  navItems.forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => {
      navItems.forEach(nav => nav.classList.remove('active'));
      item.classList.add('active');
      currentFilter = item.dataset.filter || 'all';

      if (currentFilter === 'all') sectionTitle.textContent = 'Tất cả tệp tải xuống';
      else if (currentFilter === 'downloading') sectionTitle.textContent = 'Đang tải xuống';
      else if (currentFilter === 'completed') sectionTitle.textContent = 'Đã hoàn thành';
      else if (currentFilter === 'video') sectionTitle.textContent = 'Video & Phim';
      else if (currentFilter === 'audio') sectionTitle.textContent = 'Âm thanh & MP3';

      renderList();
    });
  });

  // Search input
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    searchQuery = searchInput.value.trim();
    btnClearSearch.style.display = searchQuery ? 'block' : 'none';
    renderList();
  });

  btnClearSearch.addEventListener('click', () => {
    searchInput.value = '';
    searchQuery = '';
    btnClearSearch.style.display = 'none';
    renderList();
  });

  // Open Downloads folder
  btnOpenFolder.addEventListener('click', () => {
    safeSendMessage({ action: 'openDownloadsFolder' });
  });

  // Change folder
  btnChangeFolder.addEventListener('click', () => {
    safeSendMessage({ action: 'browseFolder' }, (res) => {
      const selectedPath = (res && res.path) || (res && res.success && res.path);
      if (selectedPath) {
        sidebarFolderPath.textContent = selectedPath;
        sidebarFolderPath.title = selectedPath;
        if (modalFolderPath) {
          modalFolderPath.textContent = selectedPath;
          modalFolderPath.title = selectedPath;
        }
        chrome.storage.local.set({ customDownloadDir: selectedPath });
        showToast('Đã đổi thư mục lưu!');
      }
    });
  });

  // Settings Modal Elements
  const btnSettings = null; /* settings panel is always visible now */
  const settingsModal = document.getElementById('settings-modal');
  const btnSaveSettings = null; /* settings auto-save on change */
  const modalFolderPath = document.getElementById('modal-folder-path');
  const btnModalChangeFolder = document.getElementById('btn-modal-change-folder');
  const settingOnpageButtons = document.getElementById('setting-onpage-buttons');
  const settingImageButtons = document.getElementById('setting-image-buttons');
  const settingDetachButton = null; /* dead feature removed */
  let cachedDetachEnabled = undefined;
  let cachedDetachButtonEnabled = undefined;
  const settingOneClick = null; /* 1-Click removed per product decision */
  const setting3gp = null; /* 3GP removed — desktop product */
  const settingPreferredQuality = null; /* default-quality setting removed per product decision */
  const settingRememberQuality = null; /* remember-quality setting removed per product decision */
  // Advanced settings (merged from the retired options page)
  const settingMinSize = document.getElementById('setting-min-size');
  const settingMinSizeValue = document.getElementById('setting-min-size-value');
  const settingSiteInput = document.getElementById('setting-site-input');
  const btnAddSite = document.getElementById('btn-add-site');
  const settingsSiteList = document.getElementById('settings-site-list');

  function beautifySize(bytes) {
    const b = Number(bytes) || 0;
    if (b >= 1024 * 1024) return (b / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + ' MB';
    if (b >= 1024) return Math.round(b / 1024) + ' KB';
    return b + ' B';
  }

  function renderSettingsSiteList(sites) {
    if (!settingsSiteList) return;
    const items = Array.isArray(sites) ? sites : [];
    settingsSiteList.replaceChildren();
    if (items.length === 0) {
      const empty = document.createElement('span');
      empty.style.cssText = 'font-size:12.5px;color:#9ca3af;';
      empty.textContent = 'Chưa có website nào trong danh sách';
      settingsSiteList.appendChild(empty);
      return;
    }
    for (const domain of items) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;';

      const avatar = document.createElement('span');
      avatar.style.cssText = 'display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:4px;background:#10b981;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;flex:0 0 20px;';
      avatar.textContent = String(domain).charAt(0) || '?';
      row.appendChild(avatar);

      const name = document.createElement('span');
      name.style.cssText = 'flex:1;font-size:13px;word-break:break-all;';
      name.textContent = domain;
      row.appendChild(name);

      const del = document.createElement('button');
      del.type = 'button';
      del.title = 'Xoá';
      del.textContent = '✕';
      del.style.cssText = 'border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;color:#ef4444;font-size:13px;padding:2px 6px;';
      del.addEventListener('click', () => {
        chrome.storage.local.get(['disable_savior_sites'], (s) => {
          const list = Array.isArray(s.disable_savior_sites) ? s.disable_savior_sites : [];
          const next = list.filter((d) => d !== domain);
          chrome.storage.local.set({ disable_savior_sites: next }, () => {
            renderSettingsSiteList(next);
            showToast('Đã xoá ' + domain + ' khỏi danh sách');
          });
        });
      });
      row.appendChild(del);
      settingsSiteList.appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  function addSiteFromInput() {
    if (!settingSiteInput) return;
    const raw = String(settingSiteInput.value || '').trim().toLowerCase()
      .replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')
      .replace(/^www\./, '')
      .replace(/\/.*$/, '');
    if (!/^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$/.test(raw)) {
      showToast('Tên miền không hợp lệ. Ví dụ: example.com');
      return;
    }
    chrome.storage.local.get(['disable_savior_sites'], (s) => {
      const list = Array.isArray(s.disable_savior_sites) ? s.disable_savior_sites : [];
      if (list.includes(raw)) {
        showToast(raw + ' đã có trong danh sách');
        return;
      }
      const next = list.concat(raw);
      chrome.storage.local.set({ disable_savior_sites: next }, () => {
        settingSiteInput.value = '';
        renderSettingsSiteList(next);
        showToast('Đã thêm ' + raw + ' — thanh tải nổi sẽ ẩn trên trang này');
      });
    });
  }

  function loadSettingsIntoUI() {
    chrome.storage.local.get([
      'customDownloadDir',
      'onPageButtonsEnabled',
      'on_page_buttons',
      'image_download_enabled',
      'imageDownloadEnabled',
      'detachButtonEnabled',
      'detach_enabled',
      'one_click',
      'isOneClickEnabled',
      'one_click_download',
      'preferLastQuality',
      'prefer_last_quality',
      'show_3gp_ext',
      'min_stream_size',
      'disable_savior_sites'
    ], (data) => {
      const currentDir = data.customDownloadDir || (sidebarFolderPath ? sidebarFolderPath.textContent : '') || 'Downloads';
      if (modalFolderPath) {
        modalFolderPath.textContent = currentDir;
        modalFolderPath.title = currentDir;
      }
      if (sidebarFolderPath) {
        sidebarFolderPath.textContent = currentDir;
        sidebarFolderPath.title = currentDir;
      }
      cachedDetachEnabled = data.detach_enabled;
      cachedDetachButtonEnabled = data.detachButtonEnabled;
      const onPageVal = data.on_page_buttons !== undefined ? data.on_page_buttons : data.onPageButtonsEnabled;
      const imageVal = data.image_download_enabled !== undefined ? data.image_download_enabled : data.imageDownloadEnabled;
      const detachVal = data.detach_enabled !== undefined ? data.detach_enabled : data.detachButtonEnabled;
      const oneClickVal = data.one_click !== undefined ? data.one_click : (data.one_click_download !== undefined ? data.one_click_download : data.isOneClickEnabled);
      const rememberVal = data.prefer_last_quality !== undefined ? data.prefer_last_quality : data.preferLastQuality;

      if (settingOnpageButtons) settingOnpageButtons.checked = onPageVal !== false;
      if (settingImageButtons) settingImageButtons.checked = imageVal !== false;
      if (settingDetachButton) settingDetachButton.checked = detachVal !== false;
      if (settingOneClick) settingOneClick.checked = Boolean(oneClickVal);
      if (settingRememberQuality) settingRememberQuality.checked = rememberVal !== false;
      if (setting3gp) setting3gp.checked = data.show_3gp_ext === true;
      if (settingMinSize) {
        settingMinSize.value = Number(data.min_stream_size) > 0 ? Number(data.min_stream_size) : 0;
        if (settingMinSizeValue) settingMinSizeValue.textContent = beautifySize(settingMinSize.value);
      }
      renderSettingsSiteList(data.disable_savior_sites);
    });
  }

  function saveSettings(showSuccessToast = true) {
    const onPage = settingOnpageButtons ? settingOnpageButtons.checked : true;
    const imageEnabled = settingImageButtons ? settingImageButtons.checked : true;
    const oneClick = settingOneClick ? settingOneClick.checked : false;
    const rememberQuality = settingRememberQuality ? settingRememberQuality.checked : true;

    const detach = settingDetachButton ? settingDetachButton.checked : (cachedDetachEnabled !== undefined ? cachedDetachEnabled : false);
    const detachBtn = settingDetachButton ? settingDetachButton.checked : (cachedDetachButtonEnabled !== undefined ? cachedDetachButtonEnabled : detach);

    const settingsToSave = {
      // camelCase format (for downloads manager UI)
      onPageButtonsEnabled: onPage,
      imageDownloadEnabled: imageEnabled,
      detachButtonEnabled: detachBtn,
      isOneClickEnabled: oneClick,
      preferLastQuality: rememberQuality,
      // snake_case format (for content-script.js & options engine)
      on_page_buttons: onPage,
      image_download_enabled: imageEnabled,
      detach_enabled: detach,
      one_click: oneClick,
      one_click_download: oneClick,
      prefer_last_quality: rememberQuality,
      show_3gp_ext: setting3gp ? setting3gp.checked : false,
      min_stream_size: settingMinSize ? (Number(settingMinSize.value) || 0) : 30720
    };

    chrome.storage.local.set(settingsToSave, () => {
      if (showSuccessToast) {
        showToast('Đã lưu cài đặt thành công!');
      }
    });
  }

  // The settings panel is a permanent right sidebar — no open/close modal flow.
  // Settings load once on start and every change saves immediately.
  loadSettingsIntoUI();

  // Auto-save when user toggles or changes any setting directly
  if (settingOnpageButtons) settingOnpageButtons.addEventListener('change', () => saveSettings(true));
  if (settingImageButtons) settingImageButtons.addEventListener('change', () => saveSettings(true));
  if (settingRememberQuality) settingRememberQuality.addEventListener('change', () => saveSettings(true));
  if (settingMinSize) {
    settingMinSize.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (settingMinSizeValue) settingMinSizeValue.textContent = beautifySize(settingMinSize.value);
    });
    settingMinSize.addEventListener('change', () => saveSettings(true));
  }
  if (btnAddSite) btnAddSite.addEventListener('click', addSiteFromInput);
  if (settingSiteInput) {
    settingSiteInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        addSiteFromInput();
      }
    });
  }

  if (btnModalChangeFolder) {
    btnModalChangeFolder.addEventListener('click', () => {
      safeSendMessage({ action: 'browseFolder' }, (res) => {
        if (!res || res.canceled) return;
        const selectedPath = (res && res.path) || (res && res.success && res.path);
        if (selectedPath) {
          if (modalFolderPath) {
            modalFolderPath.textContent = selectedPath;
            modalFolderPath.title = selectedPath;
          }
          if (sidebarFolderPath) {
            sidebarFolderPath.textContent = selectedPath;
            sidebarFolderPath.title = selectedPath;
          }
          chrome.storage.local.set({ customDownloadDir: selectedPath });
          showToast('Đã đổi thư mục lưu!');
        }
      });
    });
  }

  if (btnSaveSettings) {
    btnSaveSettings.addEventListener('click', () => {
      saveSettings(true);
    });
  }

  // Clear all history
  btnClearAll.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (confirm('Bạn có chắc muốn xoá toàn bộ lịch sử tải xuống không?')) {
      for (const it of allItems) {
        const strId = String(it.id || '');
        const strChromeId = it.chromeId ? String(it.chromeId) : '';
        if (strId) recentlyDeletedIds.add(strId);
        if (strChromeId) recentlyDeletedIds.add(strChromeId);

        if (it.state === 'downloading') {
          if (it.chromeId && typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.downloads) {
            try { chrome.downloads.cancel(it.chromeId); } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
        if (it.chromeId && typeof chrome !== 'undefined' && chrome.downloads && chrome.downloads.erase) {
          try { chrome.downloads.erase({ id: it.chromeId }, () => {}); } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
      allItems = [];
      safeSendMessage({ action: 'clearHistory' });
      await chrome.storage.local.set({ downloadHistory: [] });
      updateCounts();
      renderList();
      showToast('Đã xoá toàn bộ lịch sử tải xuống!');
    }
  });

  function syncHistoryUpdatesInPlace(newHistory) {
    if (!Array.isArray(newHistory)) return;

    const normalizedNew = [];
    const newHistoryMap = new Map();

    for (const raw of newHistory) {
      if (!raw) continue;
      const strId = String(raw.id || '');
      const strChromeId = raw.chromeId ? String(raw.chromeId) : '';
      if (recentlyDeletedIds.has(strId) || (strChromeId && recentlyDeletedIds.has(strChromeId))) {
        continue;
      }

      const item = { ...raw, fromHistory: true };
      if (item.state === 'in_progress') item.state = 'downloading';
      if (item.state === 'complete') item.state = 'completed';
      if (item.state === 'interrupted' && item.error !== 'USER_CANCELED') item.state = 'error';
      if (item.state === 'cancelled' || item.error === 'USER_CANCELED') item.state = 'canceled';

      const isFinished = item.percent === '100%' || item.speed === 'Hoàn thành';
      if (isFinished && item.state !== 'canceled' && item.state !== 'deleted' && item.state !== 'error') {
        item.state = 'completed';
      }
      if (!item.errorMessage && item.error) {
        item.errorMessage = formatErrorMessage(item.error);
      }

      normalizedNew.push(item);
      if (strId) newHistoryMap.set(strId, item);
      if (strChromeId) newHistoryMap.set(strChromeId, item);
    }

    if (allItems.length === 0 && downloadsContainer && downloadsContainer.children.length === 0) {
      allItems = [...normalizedNew].sort((a, b) => (b.startTime || 0) - (a.startTime || 0));
      updateCounts();
      renderList();
      return;
    }

    for (const newItem of normalizedNew) {
      const strId = String(newItem.id || '');
      const strChromeId = newItem.chromeId ? String(newItem.chromeId) : '';

      let existing = allItems.find(it => {
        const itId = String(it.id || '');
        const itChromeId = it.chromeId ? String(it.chromeId) : '';
        if (strId && (itId === strId || itChromeId === strId)) return true;
        if (strChromeId && (itChromeId === strChromeId || itId === strChromeId)) return true;
        return false;
      });

      if (existing) {
        const stateChanged = existing.state !== newItem.state;
        Object.assign(existing, newItem);

        const card = document.getElementById(`card_${existing.id}`) ||
          (existing.chromeId ? document.getElementById(`card_${existing.chromeId}`) : null);

        if (card) {
          if (stateChanged) {
            const newCard = createDownloadCard(existing);
            card.replaceWith(newCard);
          } else if (existing.state === 'downloading') {
            const progFill = card.querySelector('.item-progress-fill');
            if (progFill) {
              progFill.style.width = formatPercentWidth(existing.percent);
            }
            const stats = card.querySelector('.item-downloading-stats');
            if (stats) {
              const spd = existing.speed ? ` • ${existing.speed}` : '';
              const displayPct = (existing.percent && existing.percent.includes('%'))
                ? existing.percent
                : (existing.speed ? 'Đang tải...' : '0%');
              stats.textContent = `${displayPct}${spd}`;
            }
          } else if (existing.state === 'error') {
            const errDesc = card.querySelector('.error-badge-text');
            if (errDesc && existing.errorMessage) {
              errDesc.textContent = existing.errorMessage;
              errDesc.title = existing.errorMessage;
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        // New item added to history
        allItems.unshift(newItem);
        const filtered = getFilteredItems();
        if (filtered.includes(newItem)) {
          if (emptyState) emptyState.style.display = 'none';
          const headingText = getDateGroupHeading(newItem.startTime);
          let targetGroup = null;
          const groups = downloadsContainer ? downloadsContainer.querySelectorAll('.date-group') : [];
          for (const grp of groups) {
            const hdr = grp.querySelector('.date-group-heading');
            if (hdr && hdr.textContent === headingText) {
              targetGroup = grp;
              break;
            }
          }
          const card = createDownloadCard(newItem);
          if (targetGroup) {
            const headingEl = targetGroup.querySelector('.date-group-heading');
            if (headingEl) {
              headingEl.after(card);
            } else {
              targetGroup.prepend(card);
            }
          } else if (downloadsContainer) {
            const newGroup = document.createElement('div');
            newGroup.className = 'date-group';
            const newHeader = document.createElement('div');
            newHeader.className = 'date-group-heading';
            newHeader.textContent = headingText;
            newGroup.appendChild(newHeader);
            newGroup.appendChild(card);
            downloadsContainer.prepend(newGroup);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Remove pruned items
    const toRemove = [];
    for (const item of allItems) {
      if (item.isChromeOnly) continue;
      const strId = String(item.id || '');
      const strChromeId = item.chromeId ? String(item.chromeId) : '';
      const inNew = (strId && newHistoryMap.has(strId)) || (strChromeId && newHistoryMap.has(strChromeId));
      if (!inNew) {
        toRemove.push(item);
      }
    }

    for (const item of toRemove) {
      const idx = allItems.indexOf(item);
      if (idx !== -1) allItems.splice(idx, 1);
      const card = document.getElementById(`card_${item.id}`) ||
        (item.chromeId ? document.getElementById(`card_${item.chromeId}`) : null);
      if (card) {
        const parentGroup = card.closest('.date-group');
        card.remove();
        if (parentGroup && !parentGroup.querySelector('.download-card')) {
          parentGroup.remove();
        }
      }
    }

    if (downloadsContainer && downloadsContainer.querySelectorAll('.download-card').length === 0) {
      if (emptyState) emptyState.style.display = 'block';
    }

    updateCounts();
    if (sectionStats) {
      sectionStats.textContent = `${getFilteredItems().length} tệp`;
    }
  }

  // Auto-Sync 1: Listen to storage changes directly (zero latency cross-tab sync)
  chrome.storage.onChanged.addListener((changes, areaName) => {
    if (areaName === 'local') {
      if (changes.customDownloadDir) {
        const newPath = changes.customDownloadDir.newValue;
        if (newPath) {
          if (sidebarFolderPath) {
            sidebarFolderPath.textContent = newPath;
            sidebarFolderPath.title = newPath;
          }
          if (modalFolderPath) {
            modalFolderPath.textContent = newPath;
            modalFolderPath.title = newPath;
          }
          showToast('Đã đổi thư mục lưu!');
        }
      }
      if (changes.downloadHistory) {
        syncHistoryUpdatesInPlace(changes.downloadHistory.newValue);
      }
    }
  });

  // Auto-Sync 2: Real-time progress events from background service worker
  chrome.runtime.onMessage.addListener((msg) => {
    if (msg.action === 'nativeProgress') {
      const activeItem = msg.taskId ? allItems.find(it => String(it.id) === String(msg.taskId)) : null;
      if (activeItem) {
        activeItem.percent = msg.percent || activeItem.percent;
        activeItem.speed = msg.speed || activeItem.speed;
        if (msg.size) activeItem.sizeFormatted = msg.size;
        updateCardProgressInDOM(activeItem);
      } else {
        loadDownloads();
      }
    } else if (msg.action === 'nativeComplete' || msg.action === 'nativeError' || msg.action === 'nativeCanceled') {
      loadDownloads();
    } else if (msg.action === 'openFileResult' && !msg.success && msg.fileNotFound) {
      const missingId = msg.id || msg.taskId;
      const target = missingId
        ? allItems.find(it => String(it.id) === String(missingId) || String(it.chromeId) === String(missingId))
        : null;
      if (target) {
        target.state = 'deleted';
        renderList();
      } else {
        loadDownloads();
      }
      showToast('Tệp không còn trên đĩa. Bấm Thử lại để tải lại.');
    }
  });

  // Auto-Sync 3: Heartbeat interval (syncs every 800ms while any download is running)
  setInterval(async () => {
    const hasActive = allItems.some(it => it.state === 'downloading');
    if (hasActive) {
      try {
        const data = await chrome.storage.local.get(['downloadHistory']);
        if (data && Array.isArray(data.downloadHistory)) {
          syncHistoryUpdatesInPlace(data.downloadHistory);
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }, 800);

  // Initial load
  loadDownloads();
});
</file>

<file path="scripts/build_content_script.js">
/**
 * scripts/build_content_script.js
 * 
 * Production & Dev Build Pipeline using esbuild
 * 
 * Pipeline mechanism:
 * 1. Reads the CSS prefetcher header from src/content/entry/index.js.
 * 2. Assembles the 776-slot module array mapped via src/content/module-registry.js.
 * 3. Wraps the module array into the classic Webpack IIFE bootstrap (entry module 543).
 * 4. Compiles using esbuild (supports --dev for unminified output + sourcemaps).
 */

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const esbuild = require('esbuild');
const zlib = require('zlib');

const isDev = process.argv.includes('--dev');
console.log(`=== BUILDING CONTENT SCRIPT PIPELINE (${isDev ? 'DEVELOPMENT MODE' : 'RELEASE MODE'}) ===\n`);

const ROOT_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const CONTENT_DIR = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'src', 'content');
const registry = require(path.join(CONTENT_DIR, 'module-registry.js'));

// 1. Read prefetcher header
const entryPath = path.join(CONTENT_DIR, 'entry', 'index.js');
const entrySource = fs.readFileSync(entryPath, 'utf8');
const section2Idx = entrySource.indexOf('// --- SECTION 2:');
if (section2Idx === -1) {
  throw new Error('Could not locate SECTION 2 marker in entry/index.js');
}
const prefetcherCode = entrySource.slice(0, section2Idx).trim();

// 2. Read each module
const slotCodes = [];
const regenPattern = /function\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_$]+)\s*\(\)\s*\{\s*\/\*!\s*regenerator-runtime[\s\S]*?\(\s*\1\s*=\s*function\s*\(\)\s*\{\s*return\s*\{\s*w:\s*[a-zA-Z0-9_$]+\s*,\s*m:\s*[a-zA-Z0-9_$]+\s*\}\s*;?\s*\}\s*\)\s*\(\s*\)\s*;?\s*\}/g;
let deduplicatedRegenCount = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < 776; i++) {
  if (!registry.modules[i]) {
    slotCodes.push('null');
  } else {
    const p = path.join(CONTENT_DIR, registry.modules[i]);
    let c = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8');
    c = c.replace(/^export default\s+/m, '').replace(/^module\.exports\s*=\s*/m, '').trim();
    if (c.endsWith(';')) c = c.slice(0, -1);
    if (regenPattern.test(c)) {
      c = c.replace(regenPattern, 'var $1 = _saviorRegen;');
      deduplicatedRegenCount++;
    }
    slotCodes.push(c);
  }
}
console.log(`Deduplicated inlined regenerator-runtime in ${deduplicatedRegenCount} modules.`);

const arrayCode = '[' + slotCodes.join(',') + ']';

// 3. Webpack bootstrap with canonical shared regenerator-core
const regenCorePath = path.join(CONTENT_DIR, 'vendor', 'regenerator-core.js');
const regenCoreCode = fs.readFileSync(regenCorePath, 'utf8').replace('module.exports =', 'return');
const sharedRegenDeclaration = `var _saviorRegen = (function(){${regenCoreCode}})();`;

const bootstrap = `${sharedRegenDeclaration}\n!function(t){var e={};function r(n){if(e[n])return e[n].exports;var i=e[n]={i:n,l:!1,exports:{}};return t[n].call(i.exports,i,i.exports,r),i.l=!0,i.exports}r.m=t,r.c=e,r.d=function(t,e,n){r.o(t,e)||Object.defineProperty(t,e,{enumerable:!0,get:n})},r.r=function(t){"undefined"!=typeof Symbol&&Symbol.toStringTag&&Object.defineProperty(t,Symbol.toStringTag,{value:"Module"}),Object.defineProperty(t,"__esModule",{value:!0})},r.t=function(t,e){if(1&e&&(t=r(t)),8&e)return t;if(4&e&&"object"==typeof t&&t&&t.__esModule)return t;var n=Object.create(null);if(r.r(n),Object.defineProperty(n,"default",{enumerable:!0,value:t}),2&e&&"string"!=typeof t)for(var i in t)r.d(n,i,function(e){return t[e]}.bind(null,i));return n},r.n=function(t){var e=t&&t.__esModule?function(){return t.default}:function(){return t};return r.d(e,"a",e),e},r.o=function(t,e){return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(t,e)},r.p="./",r(r.s=543)}(${arrayCode});`;

// 4. Transform using esbuild
const minPrefetcher = esbuild.transformSync(prefetcherCode, {
  target: 'chrome116',
  minifyWhitespace: !isDev,
  minifySyntax: false,
  minifyIdentifiers: false,
  sourcemap: isDev ? 'inline' : false,
  legalComments: 'none'
}).code;

const minBootstrap = esbuild.transformSync(bootstrap, {
  target: 'chrome116',
  minifyWhitespace: !isDev,
  minifySyntax: !isDev,
  minifyIdentifiers: false,
  sourcemap: isDev ? 'inline' : false,
  legalComments: 'none'
}).code;

const finalCode = minPrefetcher + '\n' + minBootstrap;
const outPath = path.join(ROOT_DIR, 'content-script.js');
fs.writeFileSync(outPath, finalCode, 'utf8');

const deflatedSize = zlib.deflateRawSync(Buffer.from(finalCode), { level: 9 }).length;
const rawByteLength = Buffer.byteLength(finalCode, 'utf8');
console.log(`Generated content-script.js: ${rawByteLength} bytes raw (${finalCode.length} UTF-16 chars), ${deflatedSize} bytes deflated.`);
console.log('✓ Build completed successfully!\n');
</file>

<file path="native/host.js">
/**
 * Savior - Native Messaging Host for Google Chrome
 * Communicates with Chrome extension via stdin/stdout length-prefixed JSON.
 * Provides multi-threaded downloading and FFmpeg stream muxing/conversion.
 */

const { spawn, exec } = require('child_process');
const path = require('path');
const os = require('os');
const fs = require('fs');
const http = require('http');
const https = require('https');

const isWin = process.platform === 'win32';
const isMac = process.platform === 'darwin';

const BIN_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'bin');

function resolveBinary(binName) {
  const exeName = isWin ? `${binName}.exe` : binName;
  const localBin = path.join(BIN_DIR, exeName);
  if (fs.existsSync(localBin)) return localBin;
  if (isMac) {
    const macPaths = [
      `/opt/homebrew/bin/${binName}`,
      `/usr/local/bin/${binName}`,
      `/usr/bin/${binName}`
    ];
    for (const p of macPaths) {
      if (fs.existsSync(p)) return p;
    }
  }
  return exeName;
}

const FFMPEG_PATH = resolveBinary('ffmpeg');
const YTDLP_PATH = resolveBinary('yt-dlp');
const DOWNLOADS_DIR = path.join(os.homedir(), 'Downloads');

function resolveTargetDir(outputDir) {
  if (outputDir && typeof outputDir === 'string') {
    try {
      if (!fs.existsSync(outputDir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(outputDir, { recursive: true });
      }
      if (fs.existsSync(outputDir)) return outputDir;
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  return DOWNLOADS_DIR;
}

// Ensure PATH contains our bin directory for ffmpeg
process.env.PATH = BIN_DIR + path.delimiter + path.dirname(process.execPath) + path.delimiter + process.env.PATH;

// Background process & thread optimization:
// Cap FFmpeg threads and set background priority so foreground video playback in the browser
// (e.g. YouTube, HLS movie streams) is never starved of CPU or dropped frames.
const FFMPEG_THREAD_LIMIT = String(Math.min(4, Math.max(1, Math.floor((os.cpus() || []).length / 2) || 2)));

function setBackgroundPriority(proc) {
  if (!proc || !proc.pid) return;
  try {
    if (os.constants && os.constants.priority && typeof os.setPriority === 'function') {
      os.setPriority(proc.pid, os.constants.priority.PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL);
    }
  } catch (_) {}
}

let activeProcess = null;
let activeMultiThreadJob = null;
let stdoutWritable = true;
const DISCONNECT_GRACE_MS = 5000;

if (require.main === module) {
  process.stdout.on('error', (err) => {
    stdoutWritable = false;
    logHost(`[stdoutError] ${err.code || err.message}`);
  });

  process.on('uncaughtException', (err) => {
    logHost(`[uncaughtException] ${err.message}`);
    if (err.code === 'EPIPE') {
      stdoutWritable = false;
      return;
    }
    // Anything else leaves the process in an undefined state: tell the
    // extension its job failed, let the message flush, then exit so a clean
    // host process replaces this one on the next connectNative.
    try {
      sendMessage({ action: 'error', error: `HOST_CRASH: ${err.message || 'uncaught exception'}` });
    } catch (_) {}
    setTimeout(() => process.exit(1), 100);
  });

  process.on('unhandledRejection', (reason) => {
    const desc = reason ? (reason.stack || reason) : 'unknown rejection';
    logHost('[unhandledRejection] ' + desc);
    // Notify once per minute at most so a recurring rejection cannot flood the pipe.
    const now = Date.now();
    if (!process._lastRejectionNotify || now - process._lastRejectionNotify > 60000) {
      process._lastRejectionNotify = now;
      try {
        sendMessage({ action: 'error', error: `HOST_REJECTION: ${String(reason && reason.message || desc).slice(0, 200)}` });
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  });
}

const LOG_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'host_activity.log');
function logHost(txt) {
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(LOG_FILE) && fs.statSync(LOG_FILE).size > 300 * 1024) {
      fs.writeFileSync(LOG_FILE, `[${new Date().toISOString()}] [Log truncated]\n`);
    }
    fs.appendFileSync(LOG_FILE, `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${txt}\n`);
  } catch (e) {}
}

logHost(`Savior Host started PID=${process.pid}`);

// Redact credentials before anything reaches host_activity.log: session cookies
// and signed-URL tokens must never be persisted next to the host binary.
function sanitizeForLog(value) {
  try {
    let s = typeof value === 'string' ? value : JSON.stringify(value);
    if (!s) return s;
    s = s.replace(/"cookie"\s*:\s*"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"/gi, '"cookie":"<redacted>"');
    s = s.replace(/"set-cookie"\s*:\s*"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"/gi, '"set-cookie":"<redacted>"');
    s = s.replace(/((?:signature|sig|token|auth|key|exp|nonce|n|rand)=[A-Za-z0-9_%\-\.]{8,})/gi, '$1=<redacted>');
    return s;
  } catch (_) {
    return '<unloggable>';
  }
}

let testMessageHook = null;
function setMessageHook(fn) {
  testMessageHook = fn;
}

// Send length-prefixed JSON message to Chrome
function sendMessage(msg) {
  if (testMessageHook) {
    try { testMessageHook(msg); } catch (_) {}
    if (require.main !== module) return;
  }
  if (!stdoutWritable) return;
  try {
    logHost(`SEND: ${sanitizeForLog(msg)}`);
    const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(msg);
    const bodyBuf = Buffer.from(jsonStr, 'utf8');
    const headerBuf = Buffer.alloc(4);
    headerBuf.writeUInt32LE(bodyBuf.length, 0);
    process.stdout.write(Buffer.concat([headerBuf, bodyBuf]), (err) => {
      if (err) {
        stdoutWritable = false;
        logHost(`[stdoutWriteError] ${err.message}`);
      }
    });
  } catch (err) {
    stdoutWritable = false;
    logHost(`[sendError] ${err.message}`);
  }
}

// Read length-prefixed JSON messages from Chrome stdin
let inputBuffer = Buffer.alloc(0);

if (require.main === module) {
  process.stdin.on('data', (chunk) => {
    inputBuffer = Buffer.concat([inputBuffer, chunk]);

    while (inputBuffer.length >= 4) {
      const msgLen = inputBuffer.readUInt32LE(0);
      if (inputBuffer.length < 4 + msgLen) {
        break; // Wait for full message
      }

      const bodyBuf = inputBuffer.slice(4, 4 + msgLen);
      inputBuffer = inputBuffer.slice(4 + msgLen);

      try {
        const msg = JSON.parse(bodyBuf.toString('utf8'));
        handleMessage(msg);
      } catch (err) {
        sendMessage({ status: 'error', error: 'Invalid JSON message: ' + err.message });
      }
    }
  });

  process.stdin.on('end', () => {
    logHost('process.stdin closed (Chrome disconnected pipe)');
    stdoutWritable = false;
    if (activeProcess || activeMultiThreadJob) {
      logHost('Process or multi-thread job is still active, giving 5s grace period before termination');
      setTimeout(() => {
        try { if (activeStreamJob) cleanupStreamJob(true); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (activeMultiThreadJob) activeMultiThreadJob.cancel(); } catch (e) {}
        try { if (activeProcess) activeProcess.kill(); } catch (e) {}
        process.exit(0);
      }, DISCONNECT_GRACE_MS);
    } else {
      process.exit(0);
    }
  });
}

function isExecutableFile(filePath) {
  if (!filePath || typeof filePath !== 'string') return false;
  // Windows launchers + macOS equivalents: .command/.sh execute in Terminal,
  // .dmg mounts, .pkg runs an installer, .app/.workflow launch — none of these
  // may be opened through the download manager's file launcher.
  return /\.(exe|bat|cmd|msi|ps1|command|sh|dmg|pkg|app|jar|scpt|workflow)$/i.test(filePath.trim());
}

// TaskId of the most recent download job — used to notify the extension when a
// job is superseded (killed because a newer job arrived).
let activeTaskId = null;

function notifySuperseded() {
  try {
    sendMessage({ action: 'cancelled', taskId: activeTaskId, reason: 'superseded' });
  } catch (_) {}
}

// ==========================================
// Stream relay job (Chrome fetches, host writes) — see handleMessage cases.
// ==========================================
let activeStreamJob = null;

function startStreamRelayJob(msg) {
  if (activeStreamJob) {
    // A previous relay still holds the pipe: drop it cleanly first.
    try { cleanupStreamJob(true); } catch (e) {}
  }
  let safeTitle = (msg.title || 'video').replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*]/g, '_').replace(/[\s.]+$/, '').trim().slice(0, 150).replace(/[\s.]+$/, '');
  if (!safeTitle) safeTitle = `Video_${Date.now()}`;
  const finalFilename = msg.filename || `${safeTitle}.mp4`;
  const targetDir = resolveTargetDir(msg.outputDir);
  const outPath = path.join(targetDir, finalFilename);
  const part = partPathFor(outPath);
  try {
    const fd = fs.openSync(part, 'w');
    activeStreamJob = { taskId: msg.taskId, fd, outPath, partPath: part, bytesWritten: 0, total: 0 };
    if (msg.taskId) activeTaskId = msg.taskId;
    logHost(`Stream relay started (task ${msg.taskId}) → "${part}"`);
    sendMessage({ action: 'streamReady', taskId: msg.taskId, ok: true });
  } catch (e) {
    sendMessage({ action: 'error', taskId: msg.taskId, error: 'HOST_STREAM_OPEN: ' + e.message });
  }
}

function cleanupStreamJob(unlinkPart) {
  if (!activeStreamJob) return;
  try { if (activeStreamJob.fd !== null) fs.closeSync(activeStreamJob.fd); } catch (e) {}
  if (unlinkPart) {
    try { if (fs.existsSync(activeStreamJob.partPath)) fs.unlinkSync(activeStreamJob.partPath); } catch (e) {}
  }
  activeStreamJob = null;
}

function handleStreamChunk(msg) {
  if (!activeStreamJob || String(activeStreamJob.taskId) !== String(msg.taskId)) return;
  try {
    const buf = Buffer.from(msg.data || '', 'base64');
    // Multi-threaded relays send each batch at an explicit file offset so
    // parallel workers may land out of order; positional writes handle both.
    const off = Number(msg.offset);
    if (Number.isFinite(off) && off >= 0) {
      fs.writeSync(activeStreamJob.fd, buf, 0, buf.length, off);
    } else {
      fs.writeSync(activeStreamJob.fd, buf);
    }
    activeStreamJob.bytesWritten += buf.length;
    if (msg.total) activeStreamJob.total = msg.total;
    // The ack doubles as a service-worker keepalive signal.
    sendMessage({
      action: 'streamAck',
      taskId: msg.taskId,
      seq: msg.seq,
      bytes: activeStreamJob.bytesWritten,
      total: activeStreamJob.total
    });
    const pct = activeStreamJob.total > 0
      ? Math.min(99, Math.floor((activeStreamJob.bytesWritten / activeStreamJob.total) * 100)) + '%'
      : '';
    sendMessage({
      action: 'progress',
      taskId: msg.taskId,
      percent: pct,
      speed: 'Đang tải qua Chrome...',
      eta: '',
      size: activeStreamJob.total > 0
        ? `${formatBytes(activeStreamJob.bytesWritten)} / ${formatBytes(activeStreamJob.total)}`
        : formatBytes(activeStreamJob.bytesWritten)
    });
  } catch (e) {
    cleanupStreamJob(true);
    sendMessage({ action: 'error', taskId: msg.taskId, error: 'HOST_STREAM_WRITE: ' + e.message });
  }
}

function finishStreamJob(msg) {
  if (!activeStreamJob || String(activeStreamJob.taskId) !== String(msg.taskId)) return;
  const job = activeStreamJob;
  activeStreamJob = null;
  try {
    fs.closeSync(job.fd);
    job.fd = null;
    // Segmented transfers must be complete before promotion: a short worker
    // would otherwise finalize a file with zero-filled holes.
    if (job.total > 0) {
      const written = fs.statSync(job.partPath).size;
      if (written !== job.total) throw new Error(`size mismatch: wrote ${written} of ${job.total} bytes`);
    }
    if (!finalizePartFile(job.outPath)) throw new Error('rename failed');
    logHost(`Stream relay completed: "${job.outPath}" (${job.bytesWritten} bytes)`);
    sendMessage({ action: 'progress', taskId: msg.taskId, percent: '100%', speed: 'Hoàn thành', eta: '', size: formatBytes(job.bytesWritten) });
    sendMessage({ action: 'complete', taskId: msg.taskId, outputFile: path.basename(job.outPath), downloadsDir: path.dirname(job.outPath) });
  } catch (e) {
    try { if (job.fd !== null) fs.closeSync(job.fd); } catch (_) {}
    try { if (fs.existsSync(job.partPath)) fs.unlinkSync(job.partPath); } catch (_) {}
    sendMessage({ action: 'error', taskId: msg.taskId, error: 'HOST_STREAM_FINALIZE: ' + e.message });
  }
}

function handleMessage(msg) {
  logHost(`RECV: ${sanitizeForLog(msg)}`);
  if (!msg || !msg.action) {
    sendMessage({ status: 'error', error: 'Missing action' });
    return;
  }

  switch (msg.action) {
    case 'ping': {
      sendMessage({
        status: 'ok',
        action: 'pong',
        version: '3.0.2',
        downloadsDir: DOWNLOADS_DIR,
        hasFfmpeg: fs.existsSync(FFMPEG_PATH),
        hasYtDlp: fs.existsSync(YTDLP_PATH)
      });
      break;
    }

    case 'download': {
      if (msg.taskId) activeTaskId = msg.taskId;
      startDownload(msg);
      break;
    }

    // ---- Stream relay: Chrome fetches, host writes ----
    // TikTok-style CDNs block non-browser TLS fingerprints, so node's own
    // requests get an HTML challenge page even with perfect cookies. For those
    // streams the EXTENSION fetches with Chrome's real network stack and pipes
    // the bytes here in base64 chunks; the file is assembled on disk exactly
    // like any native download (.part staging + atomic rename).
    case 'streamDownload': {
      startStreamRelayJob(msg);
      break;
    }

    case 'streamChunk': {
      handleStreamChunk(msg);
      break;
    }

    case 'streamEnd': {
      finishStreamJob(msg);
      break;
    }

    case 'streamAbort': {
      logHost(`Stream relay aborted by extension (task ${msg.taskId}).`);
      cleanupStreamJob(true);
      sendMessage({ action: 'cancelled', taskId: msg.taskId });
      break;
    }

    case 'browseFolder': {
      if (isWin) {
        const psScript = `Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $f = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FolderBrowserDialog; $f.Description = 'Chọn thư mục để lưu video tải về'; if ($f.ShowDialog() -eq [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::OK) { Write-Output $f.SelectedPath }`;
        exec(`powershell -NoProfile -Command "${psScript}"`, (err, stdout) => {
          const selected = (stdout || '').trim();
          sendMessage({
            action: 'browseFolderResult',
            path: selected,
            canceled: !selected
          });
        });
      } else if (isMac) {
        const osaCmd = `osascript -e 'try' -e 'set folderPath to POSIX path of (choose folder with prompt "Chọn thư mục để lưu video tải về")' -e 'return folderPath' -e 'on error' -e 'return ""' -e 'end try'`;
        exec(osaCmd, (err, stdout) => {
          const selected = (stdout || '').trim();
          sendMessage({
            action: 'browseFolderResult',
            path: selected,
            canceled: !selected
          });
        });
      } else {
        sendMessage({
          action: 'browseFolderResult',
          path: DOWNLOADS_DIR,
          canceled: false
        });
      }
      break;
    }

    case 'openFolder': {
      let folderPath = msg.path || msg.downloadDir || msg.outputDir || DOWNLOADS_DIR;
      try {
        if (folderPath && fs.existsSync(folderPath)) {
          if (fs.statSync(folderPath).isFile()) {
            folderPath = path.dirname(folderPath);
          }
        } else if (folderPath && !path.isAbsolute(folderPath)) {
          folderPath = DOWNLOADS_DIR;
        }
      } catch (_) {
        folderPath = DOWNLOADS_DIR;
      }
      try {
        let child;
        if (isWin) {
          child = spawn('explorer.exe', [folderPath], { windowsHide: true, detached: true });
        } else if (isMac) {
          child = spawn('open', [folderPath], { detached: true });
        } else {
          child = spawn('xdg-open', [folderPath], { detached: true });
        }
        child.on('error', (err) => {
          logHost(`openFolder error: ${err.message}`);
        });
        child.unref();
        sendMessage({ action: 'openFolderResult', success: true });
      } catch (err) {
        sendMessage({ action: 'openFolderResult', success: false });
      }
      break;
    }

    case 'openFile': {
      let targetPath = msg.path || '';
      let filename = msg.filename || '';
      const taskId = msg.id || msg.taskId || null;
      const baseDir = msg.downloadDir || msg.outputDir || DOWNLOADS_DIR;
      logHost(`openFile requested: id="${taskId}", path="${targetPath}", filename="${filename}", baseDir="${baseDir}"`);

      // 1. Sanitize & clean quotes or URI encoding
      if (targetPath) {
        targetPath = targetPath.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '').trim();
        try { targetPath = decodeURIComponent(targetPath); } catch (_) {}
      }
      if (filename) {
        filename = filename.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '').trim();
        try { filename = decodeURIComponent(filename); } catch (_) {}
      }

      // 2. Build search directories list
      const searchDirs = [];
      if (baseDir && !searchDirs.includes(baseDir)) searchDirs.push(baseDir);
      if (DOWNLOADS_DIR && !searchDirs.includes(DOWNLOADS_DIR)) searchDirs.push(DOWNLOADS_DIR);
      if (targetPath && path.isAbsolute(targetPath)) {
        const pDir = path.dirname(targetPath);
        if (fs.existsSync(pDir) && !searchDirs.includes(pDir)) searchDirs.push(pDir);
      }

      let resolvedFile = '';

      // Direct check: absolute path
      if (targetPath && path.isAbsolute(targetPath) && fs.existsSync(targetPath) && fs.statSync(targetPath).isFile()) {
        resolvedFile = targetPath;
      }

      // Build candidate names list
      const rawCandidates = [];
      if (targetPath) rawCandidates.push(path.basename(targetPath));
      if (filename) rawCandidates.push(path.basename(filename));

      const candidates = [];
      for (const cand of rawCandidates) {
        if (!cand) continue;
        if (!candidates.includes(cand)) candidates.push(cand);
        const c1 = cand.replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*]/g, '_');
        const c2 = cand.replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*]/g, '-');
        const c3 = cand.replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*]/g, ' ');
        if (!candidates.includes(c1)) candidates.push(c1);
        if (!candidates.includes(c2)) candidates.push(c2);
        if (!candidates.includes(c3)) candidates.push(c3);
      }

      // Direct check: candidates relative to search directories
      if (!resolvedFile) {
        for (const cand of candidates) {
          for (const dir of searchDirs) {
            const candPath = path.join(dir, cand);
            if (fs.existsSync(candPath) && fs.statSync(candPath).isFile()) {
              resolvedFile = candPath;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (resolvedFile) break;
        }
      }

      // Extension variations check (.mp4, .webm, .mkv, .mov, .ts, .m4a, .mp3)
      if (!resolvedFile) {
        const mediaExts = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mkv', '.mov', '.ts', '.m4a', '.mp3'];
        for (const cand of candidates) {
          const rawBase = cand.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '').trim();
          if (!rawBase) continue;
          for (const ext of mediaExts) {
            for (const dir of searchDirs) {
              const candPath = path.join(dir, `${rawBase}${ext}`);
              if (fs.existsSync(candPath) && fs.statSync(candPath).isFile()) {
                resolvedFile = candPath;
                break;
              }
            }
            if (resolvedFile) break;
          }
          if (resolvedFile) break;
        }
      }

      // Fuzzy check: search best match in directories
      if (!resolvedFile) {
        for (const dir of searchDirs) {
          try {
            if (fs.existsSync(dir)) {
              const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
              for (const cand of candidates) {
                const match = findBestFileMatch(cand, files);
                if (match) {
                  resolvedFile = path.join(dir, match);
                  break;
                }
              }
              if (resolvedFile) break;

              for (const cand of candidates) {
                const baseNameWithoutExt = cand.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '').trim().slice(0, 60);
                if (baseNameWithoutExt.length >= 3) {
                  const match = files.find(f => {
                    if (f.endsWith('.part') || f.endsWith('.tmp') || f.endsWith('.crdownload') || f.endsWith('.ytdl')) return false;
                    return f.startsWith(baseNameWithoutExt) || f.includes(baseNameWithoutExt) || f.startsWith(baseNameWithoutExt.slice(0, 20));
                  });
                  if (match) {
                    resolvedFile = path.join(dir, match);
                    break;
                  }
                }
              }
              if (resolvedFile) break;
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      if (resolvedFile && fs.existsSync(resolvedFile)) {
        if (isExecutableFile(resolvedFile)) {
          logHost(`openFile blocked executable launch: "${resolvedFile}"`);
          const fallbackDir = path.dirname(resolvedFile);
          if (isWin) {
            spawn('explorer.exe', [`/select,${resolvedFile}`], { windowsHide: true, detached: true });
          } else if (isMac) {
            spawn('open', ['-R', resolvedFile], { detached: true });
          } else {
            spawn('xdg-open', [fallbackDir], { detached: true });
          }
          sendMessage({
            action: 'openFileResult',
            id: taskId,
            taskId,
            filename: filename || (targetPath ? path.basename(targetPath) : ''),
            success: false,
            openedFolder: true,
            path: fallbackDir,
            error: 'Direct execution of executable files is blocked for safety'
          });
          break;
        }

        logHost(`openFile launching: "${resolvedFile}"`);
        if (isWin) {
          spawn('cmd.exe', ['/c', 'start', '""', resolvedFile], { windowsHide: true, detached: true });
        } else if (isMac) {
          spawn('open', [resolvedFile], { detached: true });
        } else {
          spawn('xdg-open', [resolvedFile], { detached: true });
        }
        sendMessage({ action: 'openFileResult', id: taskId, taskId, success: true, path: resolvedFile });
      } else {
        const fallbackDir = fs.existsSync(baseDir) ? baseDir : DOWNLOADS_DIR;
        logHost(`openFile fallback: opening folder "${fallbackDir}"`);
        if (isWin) {
          spawn('explorer.exe', [fallbackDir], { windowsHide: true, detached: true });
        } else if (isMac) {
          spawn('open', [fallbackDir], { detached: true });
        } else {
          spawn('xdg-open', [fallbackDir], { detached: true });
        }
        sendMessage({
          action: 'openFileResult',
          id: taskId,
          taskId,
          filename: filename || (targetPath ? path.basename(targetPath) : ''),
          success: false,
          openedFolder: true,
          fileNotFound: true,
          path: fallbackDir,
          error: 'File not found'
        });
      }
      break;
    }

    case 'showInFolder': {
      const baseDir = msg.downloadDir || msg.outputDir || DOWNLOADS_DIR;
      let filePath = msg.path || '';
      if (filePath) {
        filePath = filePath.replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '').trim();
        try { filePath = decodeURIComponent(filePath); } catch (_) {}
      }
      if (filePath && !path.isAbsolute(filePath)) {
        filePath = path.join(baseDir, filePath);
      }
      if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        const searchDirs = [baseDir];
        if (baseDir !== DOWNLOADS_DIR) searchDirs.push(DOWNLOADS_DIR);

        for (const dir of searchDirs) {
          try {
            if (fs.existsSync(dir)) {
              const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
              const match = findBestFileMatch(msg.path || '', files);
              if (match) {
                filePath = path.join(dir, match);
                break;
              }
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
      if (filePath && fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        if (isWin) {
          spawn('explorer.exe', [`/select,${filePath}`], { windowsHide: true, detached: true });
        } else if (isMac) {
          spawn('open', ['-R', filePath], { detached: true });
        } else {
          spawn('xdg-open', [baseDir], { detached: true });
        }
      } else {
        const fallbackDir = fs.existsSync(baseDir) ? baseDir : DOWNLOADS_DIR;
        if (isWin) {
          spawn('explorer.exe', [fallbackDir], { windowsHide: true, detached: true });
        } else if (isMac) {
          spawn('open', [fallbackDir], { detached: true });
        } else {
          spawn('xdg-open', [fallbackDir], { detached: true });
        }
      }
      sendMessage({ action: 'showInFolderResult', success: true });
      break;
    }

    case 'cancel': {
      logHost(`Received cancel command from extension.`);
      if (activeStreamJob) {
        try { cleanupStreamJob(true); } catch (e) {}
      }
      if (activeMultiThreadJob) {
        try { activeMultiThreadJob.cancel(); } catch (e) {}
        activeMultiThreadJob = null;
      }
      if (activeProcess) {
        activeProcess.isKilledByHost = true;
        const pid = activeProcess.pid;
        try {
          if (isWin && pid) {
            exec(`taskkill /F /T /PID ${pid}`, () => {});
          }
          activeProcess.kill('SIGKILL');
        } catch (e) {}
        activeProcess = null;
      }
      sendMessage({ action: 'cancelled' });
      break;
    }

    default:
      sendMessage({ status: 'error', error: 'Unknown action: ' + msg.action });
      break;
  }
}

function formatBytes(bytes) {
  if (!bytes || isNaN(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0 MB';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  let size = bytes;
  let unitIndex = 0;
  while (size >= 1024 && unitIndex < units.length - 1) {
    size /= 1024;
    unitIndex++;
  }
  return `${size.toFixed(1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;
}

function formatSpeed(bytesPerSec) {
  if (!bytesPerSec || bytesPerSec <= 0) return '';
  const mb = bytesPerSec / (1024 * 1024);
  if (mb >= 1) return `${mb.toFixed(2)} MB/s`;
  const kb = bytesPerSec / 1024;
  return `${kb.toFixed(0)} KB/s`;
}

function probeHttpRange(urlStr, headers, maxRedirects = 5) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (maxRedirects <= 0) return resolve({ supported: false, size: 0, url: urlStr });
    try {
      const u = new URL(urlStr);
      const client = u.protocol === 'https:' ? https : http;
      const req = client.request(u, {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: { ...headers, Range: 'bytes=0-0' },
        timeout: 8000
      }, (res) => {
        if (res.statusCode >= 300 && res.statusCode < 400 && res.headers.location) {
          res.destroy();
          const nextUrl = new URL(res.headers.location, urlStr).href;
          return probeHttpRange(nextUrl, headers, maxRedirects - 1).then(resolve);
        }
        let size = 0;
        let supported = false;
        if (res.statusCode === 206) {
          supported = true;
          const cr = res.headers['content-range'] || '';
          const m = cr.match(/\/(\d+)/);
          if (m) size = parseInt(m[1], 10) || 0;
        } else if (res.statusCode === 200) {
          size = parseInt(res.headers['content-length'] || 0, 10) || 0;
          if (res.headers['accept-ranges'] === 'bytes') supported = true;
        }
        res.destroy();
        resolve({ supported, size, url: urlStr });
      });
      req.on('error', () => resolve({ supported: false, size: 0, url: urlStr }));
      req.on('timeout', () => { req.destroy(); resolve({ supported: false, size: 0, url: urlStr }); });
      req.end();
    } catch (e) {
      resolve({ supported: false, size: 0, url: urlStr });
    }
  });
}

function calculateChunks(totalSize, concurrency = 8, minChunkSize = 512 * 1024) {
  if (!totalSize || totalSize <= 0) return [{ start: 0, end: 0 }];
  const numChunks = Math.min(concurrency, Math.max(1, Math.floor(totalSize / minChunkSize)));
  const chunkSize = Math.ceil(totalSize / numChunks);
  const chunks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < numChunks; i++) {
    const chunkStart = i * chunkSize;
    const chunkEnd = Math.min(totalSize - 1, (i + 1) * chunkSize - 1);
    chunks.push({ start: chunkStart, end: chunkEnd });
  }
  return chunks;
}

const httpKeepAliveAgent = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 32, maxFreeSockets: 16 });
const httpsKeepAliveAgent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 32, maxFreeSockets: 16 });

// Downloads stage into `<final>.part` and rename atomically on success, so a
// crash, kill, or second host process retrying the same title can never leave a
// corrupt file that looks complete to the user and the openFile matcher.
function partPathFor(outPath) {
  return `${outPath}.part`;
}

function finalizePartFile(outPath) {
  const part = partPathFor(outPath);
  try {
    if (fs.existsSync(part)) fs.renameSync(part, outPath);
    return fs.existsSync(outPath);
  } catch (e) {
    logHost(`finalizePartFile failed for "${outPath}": ${e.message}`);
    return false;
  }
}

function cleanupPartialFiles(outPath) {
  try { if (fs.existsSync(partPathFor(outPath))) fs.unlinkSync(partPathFor(outPath)); } catch (_) {}
}

function downloadFileMultiThread({ url, outPath, headers, totalSize, concurrency = 10, onProgress, signal }) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let fd = null;
    const partPath = partPathFor(outPath);
    try {
